CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_fantasy.member_collection_record(s text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid; inventory jsonb; opened bigint; entries bigint;
begin
 inventory:=beta_fantasy.owned_collection_page(jsonb_build_object('sport',s));
 u:=auth.uid(); -- owned_collection_page has already enforced admission/session/MFA/sport access.
 select count(*) into entries from beta_fantasy.entries e
 join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id where e.user_id=u and c.sport=s;
 -- Namespace each opening source; a purchase/entitlement alone is not an opening.
 with opening_events as (
 select 'economy:'||e.key id from credits_sandbox.state st
 cross join lateral jsonb_each(st.document->'entitlements') e
 where st.id and e.value->>'member'=u::text and e.value->>'status'='OPENED'
 and coalesce(st.document->'economy'->'packs'->e.key->'product'->>'sport',
 st.document->'commerce'->'products'->(st.document->'commerce'->'orders'->(e.value->>'order')->>'product')->>'sport')=s
 union
 select 'weekly:'||id::text from sports_feed.weekly_core_packs where user_id=u and sport=s and opened_at is not null
 union
 select 'legacy:'||p.id::text from beta_fantasy.packs p
 where p.user_id=u and p.opened_at is not null and exists(
 select 1 from beta_fantasy.pack_items i join beta_fantasy.cards c on c.id=i.card_id
 join beta_fantasy.editions d on d.id=c.edition_id join beta_fantasy.players pl on pl.id=d.player_id
 where i.pack_id=p.id and pl.sport=s)
 ) select count(*) into opened from opening_events;
 return jsonb_build_object('member',u,'sport',s,'total',inventory->'total','counts',inventory->'counts',
 'entries',entries,'opened',opened,'revision',inventory->'revision');
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_fantasy.owned_collection_page(f jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid; sport_id text:=coalesce(f->>'sport','nfl'); result jsonb;
begin
 u:=beta_fantasy.production_eligible();
 if u is null or not coalesce(beta_private.active_member_session(),false) then raise exception 'Active admitted session required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if sport_id not in ('nfl','basketball','afl','nrl') then raise exception 'Unsupported collection sport';end if;
 if sport_id<>'nfl' then
  if current_setting('docked.private_beta_sport',true) is distinct from sport_id
    or sports_feed.private_beta_sport_identity() is distinct from u then raise exception 'Private sport access required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 end if;
 if coalesce((f->>'offset')::int,0)<0 or coalesce((f->>'offset')::int,0)>100000
 or coalesce(f->>'sort','recent') not in ('recent','rarity','name','serial')
 or length(coalesce(f->>'search',''))>80 then raise exception 'Invalid collection query';end if;

 with ledger as materialized(select document->'commerce'->'cards' commerce,
   document->'cards' cards,document->'economy'->'instances' instances,
   document->'economy'->'players' players,document->'entitlements' entitlements
   from credits_sandbox.state where id),
 beta_owned as materialized(
  select c.key id,c.value commerce,l.instances->c.key instance,
    l.cards->c.key card,l.players->(l.instances->c.key->>'playerId') player
  from ledger l cross join lateral jsonb_each(l.commerce) c
  where c.value->>'owner'=u::text and c.value->>'sport'=sport_id and l.cards ? c.key
  and (l.instances->c.key->>'source' is null
       or l.entitlements->(l.instances->c.key->>'source')->>'status'='OPENED')
 ),
 beta_rows as (
  select b.id,coalesce(b.player->>'name','Test Player '||split_part(b.id,'-',4)) name,
   coalesce(b.player->>'currentTeam','Docked Test Squad') team,coalesce(b.player->>'position','') position,
   coalesce(b.instance->>'rarity',b.commerce->>'tier') tier,coalesce((b.instance->>'serial')::bigint,0) serial,
   coalesce((select max((h->>'at')::numeric) from jsonb_array_elements(b.card->'history')h where h->>'to'=u::text),0) acquired,
   jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'inventory','beta','commerce',b.commerce-'owner'-'reserved','instance',b.instance,'player',b.player) payload
  from beta_owned b
 ),
 legacy_rows as (
  select c.id::text id,p.name,coalesce(np.current_team,p.team) team,p.position,e.tier,c.serial,
   extract(epoch from coalesce((select max(o.created_at) from beta_fantasy.ownership_events o where o.card_id=c.id and o.to_user=u),c.created_at))*1000 acquired,
   jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'inventory','collectible','card',jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'player_id',p.id,'canonical_player_id',cp.id,'name',p.name,'sport',p.sport,'team',coalesce(np.current_team,p.team),'position',p.position,'tier',e.tier,'serial',c.serial,'max_supply',case when e.tier='CORE' and cp.id is not null then 0 else e.max_supply end,'season',e.season,'edition_id',e.id,'kind',e.kind,'colour',p.colour,'shirt',p.shirt,'status',p.status,'tradeable',c.tradeable)) payload
  from beta_fantasy.cards c join beta_fantasy.editions e on e.id=c.edition_id join beta_fantasy.players p on p.id=e.player_id
  left join sports_feed.nfl_players np on np.player_id=p.id and p.sport='nfl'
  left join credits_sandbox.permanent_players cp on cp.provider='nflverse' and cp.provider_id=np.provider_id and cp.sport='nfl'
  where c.owner_id=u and p.sport=sport_id
   and not exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.pack_items pi join beta_fantasy.packs pa on pa.id=pi.pack_id where pi.card_id=c.id and pa.opened_at is null)
   -- A transferred current-ledger identity must never fall back to a stale legacy owner.
   and not exists(select 1 from ledger l where l.commerce ? c.id::text)
 ),
 weekly_rows as (select c->>'id' id,c->>'name' name,c->>'team' team,c->>'position' position,'CORE' tier,0::bigint serial,extract(epoch from(c->>'acquired_at')::timestamptz)*1000 acquired,jsonb_build_object('id',c->>'id','inventory','beta','card',c) payload from jsonb_array_elements(sports_feed.weekly_core_inventory(u,sport_id))c), owned as materialized(select * from beta_rows union all select * from legacy_rows union all select * from weekly_rows),
 summary as (
  select count(*) total,md5(coalesce(string_agg(payload::text||acquired::text,',' order by id),'')) revision,
   coalesce(jsonb_agg(distinct team order by team)filter(where team<>''),'[]') teams,
   coalesce(jsonb_agg(distinct position order by position)filter(where position<>''),'[]') positions from owned
 ),
 filtered as materialized(
  select *,array_position(array['CORE','RARE','ELITE','ULTRA_RARE','LEGENDARY','ICON'],tier) rarity_order
  from owned where (coalesce(f->>'rarity','ALL')='ALL' or tier=f->>'rarity')
   and (coalesce(f->>'team','')='' or team=f->>'team') and (coalesce(f->>'position','')='' or position=f->>'position')
   and (coalesce(f->>'search','')='' or position(lower(f->>'search') in lower(name||' '||team))>0
    or (f->'search_teams') ? team
    or ltrim(replace(f->>'search','#',''),'0')=serial::text or position(lower(f->>'search') in serial::text)>0)
 ),
 page as (
  select * from filtered
  where coalesce(f->>'revision','')='' or f->>'revision'=(select revision from summary)
  order by case when coalesce(f->>'sort','recent')='recent' then acquired end desc,
    case when f->>'sort'='rarity' then rarity_order end desc,
    case when f->>'sort'='name' then lower(name) end,
    case when f->>'sort'='serial' then serial end,id
  limit 18 offset coalesce((f->>'offset')::int,0)
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('total',s.total,'revision',s.revision,'teams',s.teams,'positions',s.positions,
  'counts',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(tier,n)from(select tier,count(*) n from owned group by tier)c),'{}'),
  'filtered',(select count(*) from filtered),
  'changed',coalesce(f->>'revision','')<>'' and f->>'revision'<>s.revision,
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(payload||jsonb_build_object('acquired_at',case when acquired>0 then to_timestamp(acquired/1000)end))from page),'[]')) into result from summary s;
 return result;
end $function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ declare u uuid; result jsonb; begin
 u:=beta_fantasy.actor(false);
 select jsonb_build_object(
 'user_id',u,'credits',beta_fantasy.balance(u),'admin',coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'aal','')='aal2' and exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles where user_id=u and role in('owner','admin')),
 'fee_bps',(select fee_bps from beta_fantasy.settings),
 'catalog',case when coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'aal','')='aal2' and exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles where user_id=u and role in('owner','admin')) then jsonb_build_object('players',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) from beta_fantasy.players p),'editions',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) from beta_fantasy.editions e),'replacements',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) from beta_fantasy.replacements r),'sales',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) from beta_fantasy.sales s),'ownership',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o)) from beta_fantasy.ownership_events o)) else null end,
 'cards',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from (select a.*,e.tier,e.season,e.kind,e.max_supply,e.player_id,p.name,p.position,p.team,p.colour,p.shirt,p.status,p.sport,exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.listings l where l.card_id=a.id and l.state='active') as listed,(select max(created_at) from beta_fantasy.ownership_events o where o.card_id=a.id and o.to_user=u) as acquired_at from beta_fantasy.cards a join beta_fantasy.editions e on e.id=a.edition_id join beta_fantasy.players p on p.id=e.player_id where a.owner_id=u and not exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.pack_items pi join beta_fantasy.packs pa on pa.id=pi.pack_id where pi.card_id=a.id and pa.opened_at is null) order by a.created_at desc) x),'[]'),
 'packs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from (select a.*,d.name,d.slots,case when a.opened_at is not null then (select jsonb_agg(card_id order by slot) from beta_fantasy.pack_items where pack_id=a.id) else null end as cards from beta_fantasy.packs a join beta_fantasy.pack_definitions d on d.id=a.definition_id where a.user_id=u order by a.created_at desc) x),'[]'),
 'shop',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)) from beta_fantasy.pack_definitions d where name<>'Replacement'),'[]'),
 'market',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from (select l.*,e.tier,e.season,e.kind,e.max_supply,p.name,p.position,p.status,a.serial from beta_fantasy.listings l join beta_fantasy.cards a on a.id=l.card_id join beta_fantasy.editions e on e.id=a.edition_id join beta_fantasy.players p on p.id=e.player_id where l.state='active') x),'[]'),
 'trades',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)||jsonb_build_object('items',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)) from beta_fantasy.trade_items i where i.trade_id=t.id))) from beta_fantasy.trades t where u in(t.sender,t.recipient)),'[]'),
 'competitions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)) from beta_fantasy.competitions c),'[]'),
 'entries',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) from beta_fantasy.entries e where user_id=u),'[]'),
 'results',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) from beta_fantasy.results r),'[]'),
 'ledger',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) from (select l.*,j.reason from beta_fantasy.ledger l join beta_fantasy.journals j on j.id=l.journal_id where account=u::text order by l.created_at desc limit 100) x),'[]'),
 'provenance',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o)) from beta_fantasy.ownership_events o where o.card_id in(select id from beta_fantasy.cards where owner_id=u)),'[]'),
 'members',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.user_id,'name',coalesce(s.display_name,'Preview member'))) from beta_fantasy.members m left join beta_private.social_profiles s on s.user_id=m.user_id and s.visibility='members' and s.status='active' where m.revoked_at is null and m.expires_at>clock_timestamp()),'[]'),
 'replacements',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) from beta_fantasy.replacements r where user_id=u),'[]')
 ) into result; return result; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_fantasy.production_read_state_before_field()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid; ch text; state jsonb; board jsonb; sid uuid; begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(71820342);
  u:=beta_fantasy.production_eligible(); ch:=beta_fantasy.production_channel();
  state:=beta_fantasy.production_read_state_v1();
  select id into sid from beta_private.social_profiles where user_id=u and status='active';
  with visible as (
    select u user_id,u display_id,'You'::text name
    union all
    select sp.user_id,sp.id,sp.display_name
    from beta_private.social_profiles sp
    join beta_fantasy.members m on m.user_id=sp.user_id and m.revoked_at is null and m.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
    join beta_public.profiles p on p.id=sp.user_id and p.disabled_at is null
    where sp.user_id<>u and sid is not null and sp.status='active' and sp.visibility='members'
      and beta_private.community_feature_allowed(u,'community_social')
      and beta_private.community_feature_allowed(sp.user_id,'community_social')
      and beta_private.community_feature_allowed(u,'leaderboards')
      and beta_private.community_feature_allowed(sp.user_id,'leaderboards')
      and beta_private.community_feature_allowed(u,'public_profiles')
      and beta_private.community_feature_allowed(sp.user_id,'public_profiles')
      and beta_private.social_profile_visible(sid,sp.id,false)
  ), totals as (
    select v.display_id id,v.name,coalesce(sum(r.championship_points),0)::bigint points
    from visible v left join (beta_fantasy.results r join beta_fantasy.production_rounds pr
      on pr.competition_id=r.competition_id and pr.release_channel=ch) on r.user_id=v.user_id
    group by v.display_id,v.name
  ), ranked as (
    select *,dense_rank() over(order by points desc) rank from totals
  ) select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.points desc,x.id),'[]') into board
    from (select * from ranked order by points desc,id limit 100) x;
  state:=state || jsonb_build_object(
    'release_channel',ch,
    'my_championship_points',coalesce((select sum(r.championship_points) from beta_fantasy.results r
      join beta_fantasy.production_rounds pr on pr.competition_id=r.competition_id

AS $function$

begin

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_fantasy.validate_prizes(items jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare item jsonb;other jsonb;seen jsonb:='[]';begin
 if items is null or jsonb_typeof(items)<>'array' or jsonb_array_length(items) not between 1 and 100 then raise exception 'Add 1 to 100 prize ranges';end if;
 for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(items) loop
  if not(item ?& array['from','to','description','type','amount'])
   or jsonb_typeof(item->'from')<>'number' or jsonb_typeof(item->'to')<>'number'
   or jsonb_typeof(item->'description')<>'string' or jsonb_typeof(item->'type')<>'string'
   or (item->>'from')::numeric<>trunc((item->>'from')::numeric) or (item->>'to')::numeric<>trunc((item->>'to')::numeric)
   or (item->>'from')::integer<1 or (item->>'to')::integer<(item->>'from')::integer
   or (item->>'to')::integer>100000 or length(btrim(item->>'description')) not between 1 and 240
   or item->>'type' not in('credits','card','pack','other')
   or jsonb_typeof(item->'amount')<>'number' or (item->>'amount')::numeric<=0
   or (item->>'amount')::numeric>1000000000 or (item->>'amount')::numeric<>trunc((item->>'amount')::numeric)
  then raise exception 'Invalid prize range';end if;
  for other in select value from jsonb_array_elements(seen) loop
   if (item->>'from')::int<=(other->>'to')::int and (other->>'from')::int<=(item->>'to')::int
   and not(item->'from'=other->'from' and item->'to'=other->'to' and item->>'type'<>other->>'type')
    then raise exception 'overlapping prize ranges';end if;
  end loop;
  seen:=seen||jsonb_build_array(item);
 end loop;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.football_candidate_check(n beta_private.scanner_candidates)

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare run beta_private.scanner_runs;s beta_private.strategy_versions;p beta_private.football_model_attempts;r beta_private.market_references;e beta_private.events;v numeric;
begin
 select * into run from beta_private.scanner_runs where id=n.run_id for share;perform beta_private.scanner_assert_worker(run.job_id);
 select * into s from beta_private.strategy_versions where id=n.strategy_id for share;select * into p from beta_private.football_model_attempts where id=n.prediction_id for share;select * into r from beta_private.market_references where id=n.market_reference_id for share;select * into e from beta_private.events where id=n.event_id for share;
 v:=beta_private.assert_football_comparison(p.id,s.id,r.id,n.purpose,n.selection);perform beta_private.scanner_assert_worker(run.job_id);
 if run.status is distinct from 'RUNNING' or run.strategy_id is distinct from s.id or run.purpose is distinct from n.purpose or run.region_policy_id is distinct from n.region_policy_id
 or p.event_id is distinct from n.event_id or n.market_id is distinct from r.market_id or n.region_policy_id is distinct from r.region_policy_id
 or n.strategy_hash is distinct from s.config_hash or n.code_commit is distinct from s.code_commit or n.model_version is distinct from p.model_version
 or n.model_evidence->>'predictionId' is distinct from p.id::text or n.model_evidence->>'inputHash' is distinct from p.input_hash or n.model_evidence->'probabilities' is distinct from p.probabilities
 or n.probability is distinct from v or abs(n.fair_odds-1/v)>0.00000001 or n.required_ev is distinct from(s.config->>'minEV')::numeric or n.minimum_odds is distinct from ceil((1+n.required_ev)/v*100)/100 or abs(n.estimated_ev-(v*r.decimal_price-1))>0.00000001
 or n.scanned_at is distinct from r.observed_at or n.scanned_at>clock_timestamp() or n.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() or n.expires_at>least((r.reference->>'sourceAt')::timestamptz+least(180,(s.config->>'maxAgeSeconds')::int)*interval '1 second',e.start_at-greatest(600,(s.config->>'safetySeconds')::int)*interval '1 second',n.scanned_at+interval '120 seconds')
 or not(s.config->'competitions' ? e.competition_id) or not(s.config->'windowsSeconds' @> to_jsonb(n.window_seconds)) or p.window_seconds<>n.window_seconds
 or extract(epoch from(e.start_at-n.scanned_at))>n.window_seconds or extract(epoch from(e.start_at-n.scanned_at))<n.window_seconds-(s.config->>'windowToleranceSeconds')::int
 then raise exception 'Immutable independent candidate linkage required';end if;
 n.created_at:=clock_timestamp();return n;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.football_fitted_input_guard()

begin

 select * into e from beta_private.events where id=new.event_id for share;
 select * into t from beta_private.football_training_manifests where id=(new.payload->>'manifestId')::uuid for share;
 foreach sid in array new.source_ids loop
  select * into s from beta_private.football_sporting_sources where id=sid for share;
  if s.id is null or s.revoked_at is not null or s.known_at>new.as_of_time or s.effective_from>new.as_of_time or s.effective_to<=clock_timestamp() then raise exception 'Current sporting rights required';end if;
 end loop;
 checked:=clock_timestamp();
 if new.created_by is distinct from beta_private.scanner_assert_actor(true) or e.id is null or e.competition_id<>'soccer_epl'
 or e.status<>'scheduled' or e.start_at<=checked or t.id is null or t.created_at>new.as_of_time
 or new.as_of_time>checked or new.input_cutoff is distinct from t.input_cutoff or new.input_cutoff>new.as_of_time
 or new.source_ids is distinct from t.source_ids or new.input_hash is distinct from beta_private.football_json_hash(new.payload)
 or not beta_private.football_sport_only(new.payload)
 or(new.payload-array['schemaVersion','event','asOfTime','calculatedAt','codeCommit','manifestId','modelVersion','mappingVersion','missingRequired','missingOptional'])<>'{}'::jsonb
 or((new.payload->'event')-array['eventId','competitionId','homeTeamId','awayTeamId','sport','startAt','status','knownAt','sourceId'])<>'{}'::jsonb
 or new.payload->>'modelVersion' is distinct from t.model_version
 or new.payload->>'codeCommit' is distinct from t.code_commit
 or new.payload->>'mappingVersion' is distinct from t.manifest->>'mappingVersion'
 or new.payload#>>'{event,eventId}' is distinct from e.id
 or new.payload#>>'{event,competitionId}' is distinct from e.competition_id
 or new.payload#>>'{event,sport}' is distinct from 'football' or new.payload#>>'{event,status}' is distinct from 'scheduled'
 or new.payload#>>'{event,homeTeamId}' is distinct from t.manifest->'canonicalAliases'->>(e.participants->>0)
 or new.payload#>>'{event,awayTeamId}' is distinct from t.manifest->'canonicalAliases'->>(e.participants->>1)
 or not coalesce(length(new.payload#>>'{event,homeTeamId}')>0 and length(new.payload#>>'{event,awayTeamId}')>0
 and new.payload#>>'{event,homeTeamId}'<>new.payload#>>'{event,awayTeamId}'
 and (new.payload#>>'{event,knownAt}')::timestamptz<=new.as_of_time
 and length(new.payload#>>'{event,sourceId}')>0
 and(new.payload#>>'{event,startAt}')::timestamptz=e.start_at
 and(new.payload->>'asOfTime')::timestamptz=new.as_of_time
 and(new.payload->>'calculatedAt')::timestamptz between new.as_of_time and checked,false)
 or new.payload->'missingRequired' is distinct from '[]'::jsonb
 or jsonb_typeof(new.payload->'missingOptional') is distinct from 'array'
 then raise exception 'Current mapped fitted-model input required';end if;
 new.created_at:=checked;return new;
end $function$

 and (new.payload#>>'{event,knownAt}')::timestamptz<=new.as_of_time and new.payload#>>'{event,sourceId}'=any(new.source_ids)
 and(new.payload->>'calculatedAt')::timestamptz>=new.as_of_time and(new.payload->>'calculatedAt')::timestamptz<=checked and(new.payload->>'codeCommit')~'^[a-f0-9]{40}$',false)
 or jsonb_typeof(new.payload->'sourceApprovals') is distinct from 'array'
 or jsonb_typeof(new.payload->'missingRequired') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(new.payload->'missingRequired')<>0
 or jsonb_typeof(new.payload->'missingOptional') is distinct from 'array'

 or cardinality(new.source_ids)<>(select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(new.payload->'sourceApprovals'))

 then raise exception 'Pre-event sporting-only input evidence required';end if;
 for approval in select * from jsonb_array_elements(new.payload->'sourceApprovals') loop
  select * into s from beta_private.football_sporting_sources where id=approval->>'sourceId';
  if s.id is null or not(s.id=any(new.source_ids)) or approval->>'provider' is distinct from s.provider or approval->>'sourceVersion' is distinct from s.source_version
  or approval->>'rightsReference' is distinct from s.rights_reference or (approval->>'knownAt')::timestamptz is distinct from s.known_at
  or (approval->>'effectiveFrom')::timestamptz is distinct from s.effective_from or (approval->>'effectiveTo')::timestamptz is distinct from s.effective_to
  or not coalesce(approval->'allowedPurposes' @> '["model_training","derived_probabilities","retained_evidence"]'::jsonb,false)
  or (approval-array['sourceId','provider','sourceVersion','rightsReference','allowedPurposes','knownAt','effectiveFrom','effectiveTo'])<>'{}'::jsonb
  then raise exception 'Source approval payload must match reviewed canonical authority';end if;
 end loop;
 for m in select * from jsonb_array_elements(new.payload->'matches') loop
  if m->>'eventId'=e.id or not(m->>'sourceId'=any(new.source_ids)) or m->>'status' is distinct from 'final'
  or not coalesce((m->>'startAt')::timestamptz<(m->>'completedAt')::timestamptz and (m->>'completedAt')::timestamptz<=(m->>'knownAt')::timestamptz
   and (m->>'knownAt')::timestamptz<=(m->>'receivedAt')::timestamptz and (m->>'receivedAt')::timestamptz<=new.input_cutoff,false)
  or m->>'competitionId' is distinct from e.competition_id
  or not coalesce(length(m->>'id')>0 and length(m->>'eventId')>0 and length(m->>'homeTeamId')>0 and length(m->>'awayTeamId')>0 and m->>'homeTeamId'<>m->>'awayTeamId'
   and(m->>'regulationHomeGoals')::integer between 0 and 100 and(m->>'regulationAwayGoals')::integer between 0 and 100 and(m->>'revision')::integer>0,false)
  or(m-array['id','eventId','competitionId','homeTeamId','awayTeamId','startAt','completedAt','knownAt','receivedAt','sourceId','revision','status','regulationHomeGoals','regulationAwayGoals'])<>'{}'::jsonb
  then raise exception 'No look-ahead in sporting results';end if;

  if s.id is null or s.revoked_at is not null or s.known_at>new.fitted_at or s.effective_from>new.fitted_at or s.effective_to<=clock_timestamp() then raise exception 'Current training rights required';end if;
 end loop;
 checked:=clock_timestamp();
 if new.actor is distinct from beta_private.scanner_assert_actor(true) or v.id is null or v.lifecycle not in('RESEARCH','FORWARD_CALIBRATION')
 or v.code_commit is distinct from new.code_commit or new.fitted_at>checked or new.input_cutoff>new.fitted_at
 or cardinality(new.source_ids)<1 or cardinality(new.source_ids)<>(select count(distinct x) from unnest(new.source_ids)x)
 or new.training_hash is distinct from beta_private.football_json_hash(new.training)
 or new.manifest_hash is distinct from beta_private.football_json_hash(new.manifest)
 or new.fitted_hash is distinct from beta_private.football_json_hash(new.fitted)
 or v.configuration->>'trainingDataHash' is distinct from new.training_hash
 or v.configuration->'parameters' is distinct from new.fitted->'parameters'
 or v.configuration->>'fittedHash' is distinct from new.fitted_hash
 or new.fitted->>'trainingHash' is distinct from new.training_hash
 or new.fitted->>'configHash' is distinct from beta_private.football_json_hash(new.fitted->'config')
 or new.fitted#>>'{diagnostics,converged}' is distinct from 'true'
 or new.training->>'schemaVersion' is distinct from 'epl-poisson-training-v1'
 or new.training->>'competitionId' is distinct from 'soccer_epl'
 or (new.training->>'asOfTime')::timestamptz>new.fitted_at
 or (new.training->>'asOfTime')::timestamptz<new.input_cutoff
 or (new.fitted->>'asOfTime')::timestamptz is distinct from (new.training->>'asOfTime')::timestamptz
 or (new.training-array['schemaVersion','competitionId','asOfTime','matches'])<>'{}'::jsonb
 or not beta_private.football_sport_only(new.training)
 or jsonb_typeof(new.training->'matches') is distinct from 'array'
 or jsonb_array_length(new.training->'matches')<20
 or jsonb_typeof(new.manifest->'canonicalAliases') is distinct from 'object'
 or new.manifest->>'mappingVersion' is null
 then raise exception 'Bound reviewed training manifest required';end if;
 if jsonb_array_length(new.training->'matches')<>(select count(distinct x->>'id') from jsonb_array_elements(new.training->'matches')x) then raise exception 'Duplicate training match';end if;
 if new.input_cutoff is distinct from(select max((x->>'observedAt')::timestamptz) from jsonb_array_elements(new.training->'matches')x) then raise exception 'Actual source observation cutoff required';end if;
 for m in select * from jsonb_array_elements(new.training->'matches') loop
  if (m-array['id','home','away','date','homeGoals','awayGoals','observedAt','sourceId'])<>'{}'::jsonb
  or not coalesce(length(m->>'id')>0 and length(m->>'home')>0 and length(m->>'away')>0 and m->>'home'<>m->>'away'
   and(m->>'homeGoals')~'^[0-9]+$' and(m->>'awayGoals')~'^[0-9]+$'
   and(m->>'homeGoals')::integer between 0 and 100 and(m->>'awayGoals')::integer between 0 and 100
   and(m->>'date')::date<substring(m->>'observedAt',1,10)::date
   and(m->>'observedAt')::timestamptz<=new.input_cutoff and m->>'sourceId'=any(new.source_ids),false)
  then raise exception 'Dated sporting-only training evidence required';end if;
 end loop;
 new.created_at:=checked;return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.market_data_config_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$

begin

 if tg_op='DELETE' then raise exception 'Provider configuration history is retained';end if;
 if tg_op='UPDATE' and (not old.enabled or new.enabled or (to_jsonb(new)-'enabled') is distinct from (to_jsonb(old)-'enabled')) then raise exception 'Material provider changes require a new reviewed version';end if;
 if tg_op='INSERT' and (new.reviewed_by is distinct from actor or new.configuration->>'provider' is distinct from new.provider or new.configuration->>'version' is distinct from new.version
 or new.config_hash is distinct from encode(sha256(convert_to(beta_private.phase5_canonical_json(new.configuration),'UTF8')),'hex')
 or new.configuration#>>'{rights,reference}' is distinct from new.rights_reference
 or not coalesce(new.configuration#>>'{rights,display}'='true' and new.configuration#>>'{rights,storage}'='true' and new.configuration#>>'{rights,derived}'='true'
 and (new.configuration#>>'{rights,rawRetentionDays}')::int between 1 and 30 and (new.configuration->>'monthlyCreditLimit')::int between 1 and 1000000
 and (new.configuration->>'pollIntervalSeconds')::int between 60 and 86400 and (new.configuration->>'horizonHours')::int between 1 and 168
 and (new.configuration->>'maxEvents')::int between 1 and 100 and (new.configuration->>'maxRequestsPerRun')::int between 1 and 20,false)
 or jsonb_typeof(new.configuration->'competitions') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(new.configuration->'competitions')<1
 or jsonb_typeof(new.configuration->'bookmakers') is distinct from 'object') then raise exception 'Reviewed bounded provider rights/configuration required';end if;
 insert into beta_private.audit_events(actor,action,subject,details) values(actor::text,'market_data_configuration',new.id::text,jsonb_build_object('provider',new.provider,'version',new.version,'enabled',new.enabled,'configHash',new.config_hash));return new;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.market_data_snapshot_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare c beta_private.market_data_config;r beta_private.market_data_payloads;m beta_private.markets;e beta_private.events;b jsonb;checked timestamptz;
begin
 if new.evidence::text is distinct from 'market_data' then return new;end if;
 select * into c from beta_private.market_data_config where provider=new.provider and enabled for share;
 select * into r from beta_private.market_data_payloads where id=substring(new.raw_private_path from 4) and new.raw_private_path like 'db:%' for share;
 select * into m from beta_private.markets where id=new.market_id for share;select * into e from beta_private.events where id=m.event_id for share;
 checked:=clock_timestamp();b:=c.configuration->'bookmakers'->new.bookmaker;
 if c.id is null or r.id is null or m.id is null or e.id is null or c.effective_from>checked or c.effective_to<=checked or r.retain_until<=checked
 or r.provider is distinct from new.provider or new.provenance is distinct from c.rights_reference or r.rights_reference is distinct from c.rights_reference
 or new.received_at is distinct from r.received_at or new.payload->'rules' is distinct from m.rules
 or e.status is distinct from 'scheduled' or new.payload->>'id' is distinct from new.id or new.payload->>'rawPayloadId' is distinct from r.id
 or (new.payload->>'sourceAt')::timestamptz is distinct from new.source_at or (new.payload->>'snapshotAt')::timestamptz is distinct from new.snapshot_at or (new.payload->>'receivedAt')::timestamptz is distinct from new.received_at
 or new.payload->>'bookmaker' is distinct from new.bookmaker or new.payload->>'operator' is distinct from b->>'operator'
 or b is null or not coalesce((b->>'knownAt')::timestamptz<=new.received_at and (b->>'effectiveFrom')::timestamptz<=new.received_at and (b->>'effectiveTo')::timestamptz>checked,false)
 or not exists(select 1 from beta_private.market_data_event_mappings where provider=new.provider and event_id=e.id)
 then raise exception 'Current market observation requires reviewed retained provider provenance';end if;
 if new.payload ? 'communityMetadata' and (new.payload#>>'{communityMetadata,sourceKind}' is distinct from 'current_provider'
 or new.payload#>>'{communityMetadata,sourceType}' is distinct from b->>'sourceType'
 or new.payload#>>'{communityMetadata,priceClass}' is distinct from b->>'classification'
 or new.payload#>>'{communityMetadata,classificationVersion}' is distinct from b->>'classificationVersion'
 or new.payload#>>'{communityMetadata,classificationEvidence}' is distinct from b->>'classificationEvidence'
 or new.payload#>>'{communityMetadata,providerEventId}' is distinct from e.source_mappings->>new.provider
 or (new.payload#>>'{communityMetadata,observedStartAt}')::timestamptz is distinct from e.start_at
 or new.payload#>>'{communityMetadata,receivedByDocked}' is distinct from 'true'
 or new.payload#>'{communityMetadata,promotionFlags}' is distinct from case when b->>'classification'='STANDARD_VERIFIED' then '[]'::jsonb else jsonb_build_array(b->>'classification') end) then raise exception 'Provider classification cannot be upgraded';end if;
 return new;
end $function$

 and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(c.configuration->'competitions') cfg where cfg->>'competitionId'=e.competition_id and cfg->>'providerCompetitionId'=map.provider_competition_id and cfg->>'mappingEvidence'=map.mapping_evidence)
 and c.configuration#>>array['bookmakers',q.bookmaker,'operator']=q.payload->>'operator'
 and c.configuration#>>array['bookmakers',q.bookmaker,'sourceType']=q.payload#>>'{communityMetadata,sourceType}'

 and c.configuration#>>array['bookmakers',q.bookmaker,'classificationEvidence']=q.payload#>>'{communityMetadata,classificationEvidence}'
 and (c.configuration#>>array['bookmakers',q.bookmaker,'knownAt'])::timestamptz<=q.received_at

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.owner_command_centre(p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_sport text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_include_staff boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare report jsonb; centre jsonb; begin
 report:=beta_private.owner_operations(p_start,p_end,p_sport,p_include_staff);
 -- Carry canonical display context; the server uses the shared competition-name
 -- projection. Saved names, IDs and immutable scoring rules remain unchanged.
 report:=jsonb_set(report,'{competitions}',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(
  x.value||jsonb_build_object('display',jsonb_build_object('mode',c.rules->>'mode','lineupVersion',c.rules->>'lineup_version','season',c.season,'week',c.round)) order by x.ordinality)
  from jsonb_array_elements(report->'competitions') with ordinality x(value,ordinality)
  join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=(x.value->>'id')::uuid),'[]'));
 with members as (
  select p.id from beta_public.profiles p join beta_private.admissions a on a.user_id=p.id
  where p.disabled_at is null and a.status='accepted'
  and (p_include_staff or (not a.administrator and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles r where r.user_id=p.id)))
 ), packs as (
  select x.value->>'member' member,to_timestamp((x.value->>'openedAt')::numeric/1000) at,x.value->'product'->>'sport' sport
  from credits_sandbox.state s cross join lateral jsonb_each(coalesce(s.document->'economy'->'packs','{}')) x
  where x.value->>'openedAt' is not null
  union all select user_id::text,opened_at,sport from sports_feed.weekly_core_packs where opened_at is not null
  union all select user_id::text,opened_at,null::text from beta_fantasy.packs where opened_at is not null
 ), activity as (
  select e.user_id::text member,e.updated_at at,c.sport,'entry' kind from beta_fantasy.entries e join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id
  union all select member,at,sport,'pack' from packs
  union all select sp.user_id::text,p.created_at,p.sport,'post' from beta_private.social_posts p join beta_private.social_profiles sp on sp.id=p.author_id where p.deleted_at is null and p.kind<>'edge'
 ), filtered as (
  select a.* from activity a join members m on m.id::text=a.member where (p_sport is null or a.sport=p_sport) and at>=p_start and at<p_end
 ), days as (
  select generate_series((p_start at time zone 'Australia/Sydney')::date,((p_end-interval '1 microsecond') at time zone 'Australia/Sydney')::date,interval '1 day')::date as report_day
 )
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'activeMembers',(select count(distinct member) from filtered),
  'packsOpened',(select count(*) from filtered where kind='pack'),
  'entriesUpdated',(select count(*) from filtered where kind='entry'),
  'posts',(select count(*) from filtered where kind='post'),
  'pendingInvitations',(select count(*) from beta_private.admissions a where status='reserved' and expires_at>clock_timestamp() and (p_include_staff or (not administrator and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles r where r.user_id=a.user_id)))),
  'suspendedMembers',(select count(*) from beta_public.profiles p join beta_private.admissions a on a.user_id=p.id where p.disabled_at is not null and (p_include_staff or (not a.administrator and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles r where r.user_id=p.id)))),
  'daily',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('day',d.report_day,'entries',coalesce(x.entries,0),'packs',coalesce(x.packs,0),'posts',coalesce(x.posts,0)) order by d.report_day) from days d left join (
   select (at at time zone 'Australia/Sydney')::date as report_day,count(*) filter(where kind='entry') entries,count(*) filter(where kind='pack') packs,count(*) filter(where kind='post') posts from filtered group by 1
  ) x using(report_day)),'[]'),
  'packFailures',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row) from (select pf.id,pf.category,pf.recorded_at from credits_sandbox.pack_failures pf join members m on m.id::text=pf.member where pf.recorded_at>=p_start and pf.recorded_at<p_end and (p_sport is null or exists(select 1 from credits_sandbox.pack_configuration pc where pc.document->>'id'=pf.product and pc.document->>'sport'=p_sport)) order by pf.recorded_at desc,pf.id limit 50) row),'[]'),
  'feedJobs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row) from (select id,provider,state,attempts,error_code,last_success,available_at,lease_until from sports_feed.jobs where state in ('blocked','leased') order by available_at,id limit 50) row),'[]'),
  'lastRosterSync',(select max(observed_at) from sports_feed.nfl_players),
  'workerRuns',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row) from (select id,started_at,finished_at,status from sports_feed.nfl_worker_runs order by started_at desc,id desc limit 10) row),'[]'),
  'weeklyEnabled',(select enabled from sports_feed.weekly_core_control where id),
  'inventorySummary',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row) from (
   select tier,sum(issued) issued,sum(cap) cap from (
    select e.tier,e.issued,e.max_supply cap from beta_fantasy.editions e join beta_fantasy.players p on p.id=e.player_id where p_sport is null or p.sport=p_sport
    union all select d.rarity,(select count(*) from credits_sandbox.card_instances i where i.definition=d.id),d.lifetime_cap from credits_sandbox.card_definitions d join credits_sandbox.permanent_players p on p.id=d.player_id where p_sport is null or p.sport=p_sport
   ) editions group by tier order by tier
  ) row),'[]'),
  'limitations',jsonb_build_array('Activity counts currently accepted, non-disabled members: saved-entry updates, opened packs and non-deleted posts, not logins or retention.','Entries use their last saved timestamp; this is not a reconstructed submission history.','Pack counts include the current credit economy, weekly rewards and legacy packs, scoped by known sport.','Inventory includes recorded beta editions across members, including staff; Core capacity is not commercial stock.','Wallet metrics are account-wide test-credit totals and are unaffected by sport or staff filters.','Feed job exceptions are current, account-wide; pack failures follow member, sport and date filters, latest 50. Unknown product sport is excluded from sport-specific failures. Worker history is latest 10.')) into centre;
 -- Keep summary/export metrics consistent with the current economy and staff definition.
 report:=jsonb_set(report,'{metrics}',(report->'metrics')||jsonb_build_object(
  'registered',(select count(*) from auth.users u join beta_private.admissions a on a.user_id=u.id where p_include_staff or (not a.administrator and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles r where r.user_id=u.id))),
  'admitted',(select count(*) from beta_public.profiles p join beta_private.admissions a on a.user_id=p.id where a.status='accepted' and p.disabled_at is null and (p_include_staff or (not a.administrator and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles r where r.user_id=p.id)))),
  'newRegistrations',(select count(*) from beta_public.profiles p join beta_private.admissions a on a.user_id=p.id where a.status='accepted' and p.disabled_at is null and p.created_at>=p_start and p.created_at<p_end and (p_include_staff or (not a.administrator and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles r where r.user_id=p.id)))),
  'packsOpened',centre->'packsOpened','activeInRange',centre->'activeMembers','teamsEntered',centre->'entriesUpdated','posts',centre->'posts'));
 return report||jsonb_build_object('centre',centre);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.owner_operations(p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_sport text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_include_staff boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare output jsonb;begin
 if not beta_private.active_member_session() or auth.jwt()->>'aal' is distinct from 'aal2'
 or not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles where user_id=auth.uid() and role='owner')
 or not beta_private.owner_gameplay_identity(auth.uid()) then raise exception 'Owner MFA required';end if;
 if p_start is null or p_end is null or p_end<=p_start or p_end-p_start>interval '366 days' or p_sport not in('football','nfl','afl') then raise exception 'Invalid reporting range';end if;
 with members as (
 select p.id,p.created_at from beta_public.profiles p join beta_private.admissions a on a.user_id=p.id
 where p.disabled_at is null and (p_include_staff or (not a.administrator and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles r where r.user_id=p.id)))
 ), activity as (
 select e.user_id,e.updated_at at,c.sport from beta_fantasy.entries e join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id
 union all select p.user_id,p.opened_at,null::text from beta_fantasy.packs p where p.opened_at is not null
 union all select p.user_id,s.created_at,s.sport from beta_private.social_posts s join beta_private.social_profiles p on p.id=s.author_id where s.deleted_at is null and s.kind<>'edge'
 union all select s.sender,s.completed_at,null::text from beta_fantasy.swaps s where s.state='accepted'
 union all select s.recipient,s.completed_at,null::text from beta_fantasy.swaps s where s.state='accepted'
 ), filtered as(select a.* from activity a join members m on m.id=a.user_id where p_sport is null or a.sport=p_sport)
 select jsonb_build_object(
 'scope','beta','generatedAt',clock_timestamp(),'start',p_start,'end',p_end,'sport',p_sport,'includeStaff',p_include_staff,
 'metrics',jsonb_build_object(
 'registered',(select count(*) from auth.users u join beta_private.admissions a on a.user_id=u.id where p_include_staff or not a.administrator),
 'admitted',(select count(*) from beta_private.admissions a where status='accepted' and (p_include_staff or not a.administrator)),
 'newRegistrations',(select count(*) from members where created_at>=p_start and created_at<p_end),
 'activeToday',(select count(distinct user_id) from filtered where at>=date_trunc('day',clock_timestamp() at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone 'Australia/Sydney'),
 'activeWeek',(select count(distinct user_id) from filtered where at>=date_trunc('week',clock_timestamp() at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone 'Australia/Sydney'),
 'activeMonth',(select count(distinct user_id) from filtered where at>=date_trunc('month',clock_timestamp() at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone 'Australia/Sydney'),
 'activeInRange',(select count(distinct user_id) from filtered where at>=p_start and at<p_end),
 'starterCards',(select count(*) from beta_fantasy.starter_claims s join members m on m.id=s.user_id),
 'teamsEntered',(select count(*) from beta_fantasy.entries e join members m on m.id=e.user_id join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id where e.updated_at>=p_start and e.updated_at<p_end and (p_sport is null or c.sport=p_sport)),
 'competitors',(select count(distinct e.user_id) from beta_fantasy.entries e join members m on m.id=e.user_id join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id where e.updated_at>=p_start and e.updated_at<p_end and (p_sport is null or c.sport=p_sport)),
 'packsOpened',(select count(*) from beta_fantasy.packs p join members m on m.id=p.user_id where opened_at>=p_start and opened_at<p_end and p_sport is null),
 'tradeOffers',(select count(*) from beta_fantasy.swaps s join members m on m.id=s.sender where s.created_at>=p_start and s.created_at<p_end and p_sport is null),
 'acceptedTrades',(select count(*) from beta_fantasy.swaps s where s.state='accepted' and s.completed_at>=p_start and s.completed_at<p_end and exists(select 1 from members m where m.id in(s.sender,s.recipient)) and p_sport is null),
 'posts',(select count(*) from beta_private.social_posts p join beta_private.social_profiles sp on sp.id=p.author_id join members m on m.id=sp.user_id where p.created_at>=p_start and p.created_at<p_end and p.kind<>'edge' and (p_sport is null or p.sport=p_sport))
 ),
 'competitions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row) from (select c.id,c.name,c.sport,c.round,c.locks_at,c.scored_at,r.version rules_version,
 (select count(*) from beta_fantasy.entries e join members m on m.id=e.user_id where e.competition_id=c.id) entries,
 (select count(*) from beta_fantasy.results x join members m on m.id=x.user_id where x.competition_id=c.id) scored_entries,
 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('member',x.user_id,'rank',x.rank,'score',x.score) order by x.rank) from beta_fantasy.results x join members m on m.id=x.user_id where x.competition_id=c.id),'[]') rankings
 from beta_fantasy.competitions c join beta_fantasy.scoring_rules r on r.id=c.scoring_id where (p_sport is null or c.sport=p_sport) and c.locks_at>=p_start and c.opens_at<p_end order by c.locks_at limit 500) row),'[]'),
 'inventory',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row) from (select e.id,p.name,p.sport,e.tier,e.season,e.max_supply,e.issued,
 e.max_supply-e.issued available_lifetime_supply,(select count(*) from beta_fantasy.cards c where c.edition_id=e.id) cards,
 (select count(distinct c.serial) from beta_fantasy.cards c where c.edition_id=e.id) distinct_serials
 from beta_fantasy.editions e join beta_fantasy.players p on p.id=e.player_id where p_sport is null or p.sport=p_sport order by p.name,e.tier limit 500) row),'[]'),
 'reports',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row) from (select id,status,created_at from beta_private.social_reports where status='open' order by created_at limit 100) row),'[]'),
 'emailFailures',(select count(*) from beta_private.outbox where state='dead' and created_at>=p_start and created_at<p_end),
 'limitations',jsonb_build_array('Gameplay activity uses saved teams, opened packs, posts and accepted trades; login is excluded.','Saved-team activity is last-update based, not a reconstructed event history. Retention cohorts are not available.','Registered means accounts linked to beta invitations, not every Supabase identity.','Inventory is a current snapshot; competition lists overlap the selected range. Table limits: 500; reports: 100.','Sport filters exclude unclassified packs/swaps rather than guessing their sport.','Synthetic beta competition scoring is not live finalisation evidence. No prizes are generated.')) into output;
 return output;
end$function$

functions.signature: beta_private.owner_reference_reporting(p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_sport text, p_include_staff boolean)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.owner_reference_reporting(p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_sport text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_include_staff boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare output jsonb; begin
 if not coalesce(beta_private.active_member_session(),false) or auth.jwt()->>'aal' is distinct from 'aal2'
 or not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles where user_id=auth.uid() and role='owner')
 or not coalesce(beta_private.owner_gameplay_identity(auth.uid()),false) then raise exception 'Owner MFA required';end if;
 if p_start is null or p_end is null or p_end<=p_start or p_end-p_start>interval '366 days' or p_sport not in('football','nfl','afl') then raise exception 'Invalid reporting range';end if;
 with members as materialized (
  select p.id,p.created_at from beta_public.profiles p join beta_private.admissions a on a.user_id=p.id
  where p_include_staff or (not a.administrator and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles r where r.user_id=p.id))
 ), days as (
  select generate_series((p_start at time zone 'Australia/Sydney')::date,((least(p_end,clock_timestamp())-interval '1 microsecond') at time zone 'Australia/Sydney')::date,interval '1 day')::date report_day
 ), registrations as (
  select (created_at at time zone 'Australia/Sydney')::date report_day,count(*) n from members where created_at>=p_start and created_at<least(p_end,clock_timestamp()) group by 1
 ), cards as materialized (
  select c.created_at at from beta_fantasy.cards c join beta_fantasy.editions e on e.id=c.edition_id join beta_fantasy.players p on p.id=e.player_id where p_sport is null or p.sport=p_sport
  union all
  select to_timestamp((i.document->>'mintedAt')::numeric/1000) from credits_sandbox.card_instances i join credits_sandbox.card_definitions d on d.id=i.definition join credits_sandbox.permanent_players p on p.id=d.player_id where p_sport is null or p.sport=p_sport
 ), recent as (
  select 'registration:'||id::text id,'registration' kind,'New member registered' title,created_at at,'/admin/preview-testers' href from members where created_at>=p_start and created_at<p_end
  union all select 'report:'||id::text,'report','Report submitted',created_at,'/admin/community/reports' from beta_private.social_reports where created_at>=p_start and created_at<p_end
  union all select 'competition:'||id::text,'competition','Competition scheduled',opens_at,'/fantasy/admin' from beta_fantasy.competitions where opens_at>=p_start and opens_at<least(p_end,clock_timestamp()) and (p_sport is null or sport=p_sport)
  union all select 'moderation:'||id::text,'moderation','Moderation action recorded',created_at,'/admin/community/reports' from beta_private.social_moderation_events where created_at>=p_start and created_at<p_end
 )
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'memberIds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(id) from members),'[]'),
  'usersCurrent',(select count(*) from members where created_at<least(p_end,clock_timestamp())),
  'usersPrevious',(select count(*) from members where created_at<p_start),
  'newUsersCurrent',(select count(*) from members where created_at>=p_start and created_at<least(p_end,clock_timestamp())),
  'newUsersPrevious',(select count(*) from members where created_at>=p_start-(p_end-p_start) and created_at<p_start),
  'registrations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row) from (
    select d.report_day as "day",coalesce(r.n,0) registrations,
     (select count(*) from members where created_at<p_start)+sum(coalesce(r.n,0)) over(order by d.report_day) cumulative
    from days d left join registrations r using(report_day) order by d.report_day) row),'[]'),
  'circulationCurrent',(select count(*) from cards where at<least(p_end,clock_timestamp())),
  'circulationPrevious',(select count(*) from cards where at<p_start),
  'moderation',jsonb_build_object(
    'content',(select count(*) from beta_private.social_reports where status in('open','escalated') and target_type in('post','comment','media','community','discussion')),
    'members',(select count(*) from beta_private.social_reports where status in('open','escalated') and target_type='profile'),
    'listings',null),
  'recent',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row) from (select * from recent where at<=clock_timestamp() order by at desc,id limit 20) row),'[]')
 ) into output;
 return output;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.pending_beta_consent(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from beta_private.admissions a join auth.users u on u.id=a.user_id cross join beta_private.admission_control c
 where c.enabled and a.user_id=p_user and a.status='accepted' and a.country='AU' and a.age_attested
 and (a.policy_versions is distinct from c.policy_versions or a.policy_digest is distinct from c.policy_digest)
 and u.email_confirmed_at is not null and not coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false)
 and coalesce((to_jsonb(u)->>'banned_until')::timestamptz,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp()
 and beta_private.beta_gameplay_identity(p_user))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.phase5_canonical_json(value jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case jsonb_typeof(value)
 when 'object' then '{'||coalesce((select string_agg(to_jsonb(key)::text||':'||beta_private.phase5_canonical_json(v),',' order by key collate "C") from jsonb_each(value)e(key,v)),'')||'}'
 when 'array' then '['||coalesce((select string_agg(beta_private.phase5_canonical_json(v),',' order by n) from jsonb_array_elements(value) with ordinality e(v,n)),'')||']'
 when 'number' then case when value::text::numeric=0 then '0' when position('.' in value::text)>0 then rtrim(rtrim(value::text,'0'),'.') else value::text end
 else value::text end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.pre_admission_session()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from auth.sessions s join auth.users u on u.id=s.user_id
 where s.user_id=(select auth.uid()) and s.id::text=(select auth.jwt()->>'session_id')
 and u.email_confirmed_at is not null and not coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false)

$function$

begin
 insert into beta_private.audit_events(actor,action,subject,details) values(new.profile_id::text,'preview_fixture_submitted',new.id::text,jsonb_build_object('fixture',true,'label','DEMO / PREVIEW PRICE','sessionId',new.session_id));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.preview_tester_capability(p_actor uuid, p_capability text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(current_setting('docked.hosted_preview_project',true)='bckkllmndoxzpzdqrevb'
 and p_actor=auth.uid() and beta_private.active_member_session()
 and p_capability in ('community_social','public_profiles','preview_market_fixtures','preview_top_docked')
 and exists(select 1 from beta_private.preview_tester_access g join beta_private.region_policies p on p.id=g.policy_id
   join beta_public.profiles m on m.id=g.user_id
   where g.user_id=p_actor and g.project_ref='bckkllmndoxzpzdqrevb' and p_capability=any(g.capabilities)
   and g.created_at<=clock_timestamp() and g.expires_at>clock_timestamp() and g.revoked_at is null
   and m.disabled_at is null and m.age_attested and m.accepted_version<>''
   and p.preview_community_only and p.approved and p.country='XX' and p.state='DOCKED_PREVIEW' and p.minimum_age=18
   and p.features @> array['community_social','public_profiles']::text[] and p.features <@ array['community_social','public_profiles']::text[]
   and cardinality(p.operators)=0 and p.evidence like 'PREVIEW TEST ONLY:%'
   and p.effective_from<=clock_timestamp() and p.effective_to>clock_timestamp() and p.review_at>clock_timestamp()
   and (p_capability in ('community_social','public_profiles') or
    coalesce((select c.granted from beta_private.consent_events c where c.user_id=p_actor and c.purpose='privacy' order by c.created_at desc,c.id desc limit 1),false))
 ),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.preview_tester_policy(p_actor uuid, p_feature text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p.id from beta_private.preview_tester_access a
 join beta_private.region_policies p on p.id=a.policy_id
 join beta_public.profiles m on m.id=a.user_id
 where current_setting('docked.hosted_preview_project',true)='bckkllmndoxzpzdqrevb'
 and p_feature in ('community_social','public_profiles')
 and a.user_id=p_actor and a.project_ref='bckkllmndoxzpzdqrevb'
 and a.created_at<=clock_timestamp() and a.expires_at>clock_timestamp() and a.revoked_at is null
 and m.disabled_at is null and m.age_attested and m.accepted_version<>''
 and p.preview_community_only and p.approved and p.minimum_age=18
 and p.country='XX' and p.state='DOCKED_PREVIEW' and cardinality(p.operators)=0
 and p.features <@ array['community_social','public_profiles']::text[] and p_feature=any(p.features)
 and p.evidence like 'PREVIEW TEST ONLY:%'
 and p.effective_from<=clock_timestamp() and p.effective_to>clock_timestamp() and p.review_at>clock_timestamp()
 order by a.created_at desc,a.id desc limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.privacy_redaction_allowed(p_user uuid, p_email text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql

AS $function$
 select current_user=pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid((select proowner from pg_catalog.pg_proc where oid='beta_private.support_privacy_redact(uuid)'::regprocedure))
 and p_email=replace(p_user::text,'-','')||'@deleted.invalid'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.profile_admission_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if not beta_private.admitted(new.id) then raise exception 'Accepted beta admission required';end if;
 if new.country<>'AU' or not new.age_attested or not exists(select 1 from beta_private.admissions a where a.user_id=new.id and a.state=new.state

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.provider_trial_active(p_rights text)

AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from beta_private.provider_trials t where provider='the-odds-api' and project_ref='bckkllmndoxzpzdqrevb' and rights_reference=p_rights and decision='APPROVED_FOR_PREVIEW_TRIAL' and revoked_at is null and reviewed_at<=clock_timestamp() and next_review_at>clock_timestamp() and effective_to>clock_timestamp()
 and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.provider_trial_requests r where r.trial_id=t.id and
 (r.reported_credits>r.reserved_credits or (r.status='FAILED' and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.provider_trial_failure_reviews review where review.request_id=r.id and review.trial_id=t.id)))))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.provider_trial_diagnostic_shape_guard()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.publication_region_matches(published_policy uuid, current_policy uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from beta_private.region_policies old_policy join beta_private.region_policies current_policy_row
 on old_policy.country=current_policy_row.country and old_policy.state=current_policy_row.state
 where old_policy.id=published_policy and current_policy_row.id=current_policy and current_policy_row.approved
 and current_policy_row.effective_from<=now() and current_policy_row.effective_to>now() and current_policy_row.review_at>now()
 and 'tips'=any(current_policy_row.features))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.recognition_snapshot_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if current_setting('docked.scanner_scheduler',true) is distinct from 'true' then perform beta_private.scanner_assert_actor(false);end if;
 if new.as_of>clock_timestamp() or new.week_end>new.as_of or date_trunc('week',new.week_start at time zone 'UTC') is distinct from new.week_start at time zone 'UTC'
 or new.payload_hash is distinct from encode(sha256(convert_to(beta_private.phase5_canonical_json(new.payload),'UTF8')),'hex') then raise exception 'Complete-week canonical recognition evidence required';end if;
 return new;
end $function$

 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE

 when 'array' then '['||coalesce((select string_agg(beta_private.reference_canonical_json(v),',' order by n) from jsonb_array_elements(value) with ordinality e(v,n)),'')||']'
 else value::text end

functions.signature: beta_private.reference_cohort_sources(p_market text, p_config jsonb, p_policy uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone, p_cohort text)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.reference_cohort_sources(p_market text, p_config jsonb, p_policy uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone, p_cohort text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, bookmaker text, operator text, price numeric, source_at timestamp with time zone, prices jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with latest as(select distinct on(q.bookmaker) q.* from beta_private.odds_snapshots q where q.market_id=p_market and q.evidence::text in ('market_data','forward_paper','live_published') order by q.bookmaker,q.source_at desc,q.received_at desc,q.id desc),
 valid as(select q.id,q.bookmaker,q.payload->>'operator' operator,q.source_at,q.payload->'prices' prices from latest q
 join beta_private.markets m on m.id=q.market_id join beta_private.events e on e.id=m.event_id
 join beta_private.community_quote_evidence v on v.snapshot_id=q.id join beta_private.source_health h on h.provider=q.provider
 where beta_private.market_data_source_current(q.id,p_at) and p_config->p_cohort ? q.bookmaker and length(btrim(q.provider))>0 and length(btrim(q.payload->>'operator'))>0 and length(btrim(h.rights_reference))>0 and length(btrim(v.classification_version))>0 and length(btrim(v.classification_evidence))>0 and v.classification='STANDARD_VERIFIED' and v.metadata->>'sourceType'='bookmaker' and v.metadata->'promotionFlags'='[]'
 and q.payload->'rules'=m.rules and q.payload->>'suspended'='false' and v.observed_start_at=e.start_at and v.provider_event_id=e.source_mappings->>q.provider
 and h.healthy and h.last_success between p_at-interval '3 minutes' and p_at and h.rights_reference=q.provenance and h.rights_reference=v.rights_reference
 and h.capabilities->>'display'='true' and h.capabilities->>'retention'='true' and h.capabilities->>'community_standard_prices'='true'
 and q.source_at<=q.snapshot_at and q.snapshot_at<=q.received_at and q.received_at<=p_at and q.source_at>=p_at-(p_config->>'maxAgeSeconds')::int*interval '1 second'
 and (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(q.payload->'prices'))=jsonb_array_length(m.rules->'outcomes')
 and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(m.rules->'outcomes') o where not(q.payload->'prices' ? o) or (q.payload->'prices'->>o)::numeric<=1 or (q.payload->'prices'->>o)::numeric>1000)
 and (select sum(1/value::numeric) from jsonb_each_text(q.payload->'prices')) between 0.95 and 1.25
 and exists(select 1 from beta_private.bookmaker_eligibility b join beta_private.region_policies r on r.id=b.region_policy_id where b.bookmaker=q.bookmaker and b.operator_group=q.payload->>'operator' and length(btrim(b.rights_reference))>0 and b.approved and b.effective_from<=p_at and b.effective_to>p_at and r.approved and r.effective_from<=p_at and r.effective_to>p_at and r.review_at>p_at and q.bookmaker=any(r.operators) and (p_cohort='pricingBookmakers' or r.id=p_policy))
 and not exists(select 1 from beta_private.bookmaker_eligibility b join beta_private.region_policies r on r.id=b.region_policy_id where b.bookmaker=q.bookmaker and b.operator_group<>q.payload->>'operator' and b.approved and b.effective_from<=p_at and b.effective_to>p_at and r.approved and r.effective_from<=p_at and r.effective_to>p_at and r.review_at>p_at)
 and (p_cohort='pricingBookmakers' or not exists(select 1 from latest pq where p_config->'pricingBookmakers' ? pq.bookmaker and pq.payload->>'operator'=q.payload->>'operator')))
 select distinct on(v.operator collate "C") v.id,v.bookmaker,v.operator,null::numeric,v.source_at,v.prices from valid v order by v.operator collate "C",v.bookmaker collate "C"
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.research_source_allowed(p_id uuid, p_purpose text, p_jurisdiction text, p_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT clock_timestamp())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select s.id=(select x.id from beta_private.research_source_versions x where x.source_key=s.source_key order by revision desc limit 1)
 and s.configuration->>'rightsState' in('APPROVED_AUTOMATED','APPROVED_MANUAL_ONLY')
 and(s.configuration->>'reviewedAt')::timestamptz<=p_at and(s.configuration->>'effectiveFrom')::timestamptz<=p_at
 and least((s.configuration->>'reviewDueAt')::timestamptz,(s.configuration->>'effectiveTo')::timestamptz)>p_at
 and s.configuration->'jurisdictions'?p_jurisdiction and s.configuration->>'commercialUse'='ALLOWED'
 and s.configuration#>>'{storage,permission}'='ALLOWED' and s.configuration#>>'{storage,immutableEvidenceAllowed}'='true'
 and case p_purpose when 'RETAIN' then true when 'DISPLAY' then s.configuration->>'publicDisplay'='ALLOWED' when 'MODEL' then s.configuration->>'modelUse'='ALLOWED' and s.configuration->>'derivedUse'='ALLOWED' and s.configuration->>'reliability'<>'TIER_4_UNCONFIRMED'
 when 'AUTOMATED_FETCH' then s.configuration->>'rightsState'='APPROVED_AUTOMATED' and s.configuration->>'automation'='ALLOWED' and s.configuration->>'robots' in('ALLOWED','NOT_APPLICABLE') and s.configuration->>'accessMethod' in('API','FEED','DATASET') and(s.configuration#>>'{etiquette,minimumIntervalSeconds}')::integer>0 and(s.configuration#>>'{etiquette,maximumRequestsPerDay}')::integer>0 else false end
 from beta_private.research_source_versions s where s.id=p_id),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.scanner_assert_actor(p_manage boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid();
begin
 if actor is null or not beta_private.active_member_session() or auth.jwt()->>'aal' is distinct from 'aal2'
 or not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles where user_id=actor and (role in ('owner','admin') or (not p_manage and role='analyst')))
 or not exists(select 1 from beta_public.profiles where id=actor and disabled_at is null)
 or not exists(select 1 from auth.users u where u.id=actor and coalesce(nullif(to_jsonb(u)->>'banned_until','')::timestamptz,'-infinity'::timestamptz)<=clock_timestamp())
 then raise exception 'Current scanner staff MFA required'; end if;
 return actor;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.scanner_assert_worker(p_job uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from beta_private.job_runs j where id=p_job and kind='edge-scan' and state='leased'
 and lease_token::text=current_setting('docked.scanner_lease',true) and id::text=current_setting('docked.scanner_job',true)
 and lease_until>clock_timestamp() and (
  (j.payload->>'origin'='manual' and exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles r join beta_public.profiles p on p.id=r.user_id join auth.users u on u.id=p.id join auth.sessions session on session.user_id=u.id where r.user_id::text=j.payload->>'actorId' and session.id::text=j.payload->>'actorSessionId' and (session.not_after is null or session.not_after>clock_timestamp()) and r.role in ('owner','admin','analyst') and p.disabled_at is null and coalesce(nullif(to_jsonb(u)->>'banned_until','')::timestamptz,'-infinity'::timestamptz)<=clock_timestamp()))
  or (coalesce(j.payload->>'origin','scheduled')='scheduled' and exists(select 1 from beta_private.feature_flags where key='edge_scanner' and enabled))
 )) then raise exception 'Active scanner worker lease and current authorization required'; end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.scanner_candidate_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare run beta_private.scanner_runs;s beta_private.strategy_versions;r beta_private.market_references;m beta_private.markets;e beta_private.events;policy beta_private.region_policies;checked timestamptz;p numeric;
begin
 if new.prediction_id is not null then return beta_private.football_candidate_check(new);end if;
 select * into run from beta_private.scanner_runs where id=new.run_id for share;perform beta_private.scanner_assert_worker(run.job_id);
 select * into s from beta_private.strategy_versions where id=new.strategy_id for share;
 select * into r from beta_private.market_references where id=new.market_reference_id for share;
 select * into m from beta_private.markets where id=new.market_id for share;select * into e from beta_private.events where id=m.event_id for share;
 select * into policy from beta_private.region_policies where id=new.region_policy_id for share;
 perform beta_private.assert_current_market_reference(r.id);checked:=clock_timestamp();
 perform beta_private.scanner_assert_worker(run.job_id);
 if run.status<>'RUNNING' or run.strategy_id is distinct from s.id or run.region_policy_id is distinct from new.region_policy_id or run.purpose is distinct from new.purpose
 or not beta_private.scanner_strategy_allowed(s.id,new.purpose) or s.config->>'method' is distinct from 'market-reference-independent-cohorts'
 or new.strategy_hash is distinct from s.config_hash
 or new.code_commit is distinct from s.code_commit or new.code_commit is distinct from current_setting('docked.scanner_commit',true)
 or r.market_id is distinct from m.id or new.event_id is distinct from e.id or r.region_policy_id is distinct from new.region_policy_id or r.selection is distinct from new.selection
 or r.configuration is distinct from s.config->'marketReference' or r.reference->'pricing' is null or r.reference->'pricing'='null'::jsonb
 or new.model_version is distinct from 'market-reference-baseline-v1' or new.model_evidence->>'referenceHash' is distinct from r.reference->>'evidenceHash'
 or new.model_evidence->>'method' is distinct from 'market-reference-baseline' or new.model_evidence->>'advantageClaim' is distinct from 'false'
 or new.model_evidence->>'validationStatus' is distinct from 'UNVALIDATED' or new.model_evidence->>'independentPredictiveModel' is distinct from 'false'
 or new.purpose='live'
 or new.model_evidence->>'codeCommit' is distinct from new.code_commit or (new.model_evidence->>'probability')::numeric is distinct from (r.reference#>>'{pricing,probability}')::numeric
 or new.model_evidence->>'configHash' is distinct from r.config_hash or new.model_evidence->>'modelId' is distinct from 'market-reference-baseline'
 or new.model_evidence->>'purpose' is distinct from 'RESEARCH_BASELINE' or new.model_evidence->>'selection' is distinct from r.selection or new.model_evidence->>'eventId' is distinct from e.id
 or (new.model_evidence->>'fairPrice')::numeric is distinct from (r.reference#>>'{pricing,fairPrice}')::numeric
 or (new.model_evidence->>'asOfTime')::timestamptz is distinct from r.observed_at or (new.model_evidence->>'generatedAt')::timestamptz is distinct from r.observed_at
 or new.model_evidence->'sourceIds' is distinct from r.reference#>'{pricing,sourceIds}' or new.model_evidence->>'sourceEvidenceHash' is distinct from r.reference->>'evidenceHash'
 or new.model_evidence->>'modelHash' is distinct from encode(sha256(convert_to(beta_private.phase5_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object('id','market-reference-baseline','version',new.model_version,'configHash',r.config_hash,'codeCommit',new.code_commit)),'UTF8')),'hex')
 or not coalesce(policy.approved and not policy.preview_community_only and policy.effective_from<=checked and least(policy.effective_to,policy.review_at)>checked and (case when new.purpose='research' then 'market_data' else 'tips' end)=any(policy.features),false)
 or new.scanned_at is distinct from r.observed_at or new.scanned_at>checked or new.expires_at<=checked
 or new.expires_at>least((r.reference->>'sourceAt')::timestamptz+least(180,(s.config->>'maxAgeSeconds')::int)*interval '1 second',e.start_at-greatest(600,(s.config->>'safetySeconds')::int)*interval '1 second',new.scanned_at+interval '120 seconds')
 then raise exception 'Trusted current scanner research linkage required';end if;
 p:=(r.reference#>>'{pricing,probability}')::numeric;
 if new.probability is distinct from p or abs(new.fair_odds-1/p)>0.00000001 or new.required_ev is distinct from (s.config->>'minEV')::numeric
 or new.minimum_odds is distinct from ceil((1+new.required_ev)/p*100)/100 or abs(new.estimated_ev-(p*r.decimal_price-1))>0.00000001
 or r.decimal_price<new.minimum_odds or r.decimal_price<(s.config->>'minOdds')::numeric or r.decimal_price>(s.config->>'maxOdds')::numeric or new.estimated_ev>(s.config->>'maxEV')::numeric
 or not(s.config->'competitions' ? e.competition_id) or not(s.config->'windowsSeconds' @> to_jsonb(new.window_seconds))
 or extract(epoch from(e.start_at-new.scanned_at))>new.window_seconds or extract(epoch from(e.start_at-new.scanned_at))<new.window_seconds-(s.config->>'windowToleranceSeconds')::int
 then raise exception 'Candidate cannot override the shared strategy calculation';end if;
 new.created_at:=clock_timestamp();return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.scanner_strategy_allowed(p_strategy text, p_purpose text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select case when s.config->>'method'='football-independent-model' then s.active and exists(
 select 1 from beta_private.football_model_versions v join beta_private.football_edge_policy_approvals a on a.model_version=v.id
 where a.strategy_id=s.id and a.revoked_at is null and a.config_hash=s.config_hash and a.code_commit=s.code_commit and v.code_commit=s.code_commit
 and case p_purpose when 'research' then v.lifecycle in('RESEARCH','FORWARD_CALIBRATION','APPROVED_FOR_CANDIDATES','APPROVED_FOR_LIVE') when 'paper' then v.lifecycle in('APPROVED_FOR_CANDIDATES','APPROVED_FOR_LIVE') when 'live' then v.lifecycle='APPROVED_FOR_LIVE' else false end)
 else p_purpose<>'live' and beta_private.legacy_scanner_strategy_allowed(p_strategy,p_purpose) end from beta_private.strategy_versions s where s.id=p_strategy),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION beta_private.social_snapshot_immutable()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commercial_billing.market_party_allowed(viewer uuid, target uuid, terms_version text, privacy_version text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select viewer is not null and viewer=auth.uid() and private.active_member_session()
 and exists(select 1 from public.profiles p join auth.users u on u.id=p.id
  where p.id=target and p.disabled_at is null and p.country='AU' and p.age_attested
   and p.accepted_version=terms_version and u.email_confirmed_at is not null
   and not coalesce(u.is_anonymous,false) and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=clock_timestamp())
   and private.public_phone_verified(p.id)
   and exists(select 1 from private.consent_events c where c.user_id=p.id and c.purpose='privacy'
    and c.granted and c.version=privacy_version and c.id=(select id from private.consent_events
     where user_id=p.id and purpose='privacy' order by created_at desc,id desc limit 1))
   and exists(select 1 from lateral(select * from private.region_policies r
    where r.country=p.country and r.state=p.state and r.effective_from<=clock_timestamp()
     and r.effective_to>clock_timestamp() order by r.effective_from desc,r.id desc limit 1)r
    where not r.preview_community_only and r.approved and r.minimum_age=18 and r.review_at>clock_timestamp()))
 and not exists(select 1 from private.social_profiles where user_id=target and status not in('active','restricted'))
 and not exists(select 1 from private.social_blocks b join private.social_profiles a on a.id=b.actor_id
  join private.social_profiles z on z.id=b.target_id where
   (a.user_id=viewer and z.user_id=target) or (a.user_id=target and z.user_id=viewer))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commercial_billing.member_record(sport_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid;answer jsonb;begin
 u:=auth.uid();
 if u is null or sport_id not in('nfl','afl','nrl') or not private.active_member_session()
 then raise exception 'Authenticated member required';end if;
 with commercial as materialized (
  select c.id::text id,d.rarity from commercial_billing.cards c join commercial_billing.definitions d on d.id=c.definition
  join commercial_billing.packs p on p.id=c.pack where c.owner_id=u and d.sport=sport_id and p.opened_at is not null
 ), owned as materialized (
  select * from commercial union all
  select p.id,p.rarity from commercial_billing.preserved_collection_rows(u,sport_id)p
  where not exists(select 1 from commercial_billing.cards c where c.id::text=p.id)
 ), counts as(select rarity,count(*)::int n from owned group by rarity)
 select jsonb_build_object('member',u,'sport',sport_id,'total',(select count(*) from owned),
  'counts',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(rarity,n) from counts),'{}'),
  'entries',(select count(*) from beta_fantasy.entries e join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id where e.user_id=u and c.sport=sport_id),
  'opened',(select count(*) from commercial_billing.packs where member_id=u and product->>'sport'=sport_id and opened_at is not null),
  'revision',md5(coalesce((select string_agg(id,',' order by id) from owned),''))) into answer;
 return answer;
end$function$
