CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commercial_billing.preserved_collection_rows(u uuid, sport_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, rarity text, serial bigint, snapshot jsonb, acquired_at timestamp with time zone, preserved jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with ledger as materialized(select document->'commerce'->'cards' commerce,
   document->'cards' cards,document->'economy'->'instances' instances,
   document->'economy'->'players' players,document->'entitlements' entitlements
   from credits_sandbox.state where id and u is not null and sport_id in('nfl','afl','nrl')),
 beta_owned as materialized(
  select c.key id,c.value commerce,l.instances->c.key instance,
    l.cards->c.key card,l.players->(l.instances->c.key->>'playerId') player
  from ledger l cross join lateral jsonb_each(l.commerce)c
  where c.value->>'owner'=u::text and c.value->>'sport'=sport_id and l.cards ? c.key
   and (l.instances->c.key->>'source' is null
    or l.entitlements->(l.instances->c.key->>'source')->>'status'='OPENED')
 ), beta_rows as (
  select b.id,coalesce(b.instance->>'rarity',b.commerce->>'tier') rarity,
   coalesce((b.instance->>'serial')::bigint,0) serial,
   jsonb_build_object('name',coalesce(b.player->>'name','Test Player '||split_part(b.id,'-',4)),
    'team',coalesce(b.player->>'currentTeam','Docked Test Squad'),'position',coalesce(b.player->>'position','')) snapshot,
   (select to_timestamp(max((h->>'at')::numeric)/1000) from jsonb_array_elements(b.card->'history')h where h->>'to'=u::text) acquired_at,
   jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'inventory','beta','commerce',b.commerce-'owner'-'reserved','instance',b.instance,'player',b.player) preserved
  from beta_owned b
 ), legacy_rows as (
  select c.id::text id,e.tier rarity,c.serial::bigint serial,
   jsonb_build_object('name',p.name,'team',coalesce(np.current_team,p.team),'position',p.position) snapshot,
   coalesce((select max(o.created_at) from beta_fantasy.ownership_events o where o.card_id=c.id and o.to_user=u),c.created_at) acquired_at,
   jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'inventory','collectible','card',jsonb_build_object(
    'id',c.id,'player_id',p.id,'canonical_player_id',cp.id,'name',p.name,'sport',p.sport,
    'team',coalesce(np.current_team,p.team),'position',p.position,'tier',e.tier,'serial',c.serial,
    'max_supply',case when e.tier='CORE' and cp.id is not null then 0 else e.max_supply end,
    'season',e.season,'edition_id',e.id,'kind',e.kind,'colour',p.colour,'shirt',p.shirt,'status',p.status,'tradeable',false)) preserved
  from beta_fantasy.cards c join beta_fantasy.editions e on e.id=c.edition_id
  join beta_fantasy.players p on p.id=e.player_id
  left join sports_feed.nfl_players np on np.player_id=p.id and p.sport='nfl'
  left join credits_sandbox.permanent_players cp on cp.provider='nflverse' and cp.provider_id=np.provider_id and cp.sport='nfl'
  where u is not null and sport_id in('nfl','afl','nrl') and c.owner_id=u and p.sport=sport_id
   and not exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.pack_items pi join beta_fantasy.packs pa on pa.id=pi.pack_id where pi.card_id=c.id and pa.opened_at is null)
   -- Current custody always wins over an obsolete owner in the older ledger.
   and not exists(select 1 from ledger l where l.commerce ? c.id::text)
 )
 select * from beta_rows union all select * from legacy_rows
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commercial_billing.receipt_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if (new.key,new.member_id,new.account_binding,new.environment,new.product) is distinct from (old.key,old.member_id,old.account_binding,old.environment,old.product)
 or (old.order_id is not null and new.order_id is distinct from old.order_id)
 or (old.gross_cents is not null and new.gross_cents is distinct from old.gross_cents)
 or (old.money_recorded and not new.money_recorded) or (old.credited and not new.credited)
 or new.refunded_cents<old.refunded_cents then raise exception 'Commercial receipt binding and accounting evidence immutable'; end if;
 return new;
end$function$

 if new.lifetime_cap is distinct from (config->'rarities'->new.rarity->>'lifetimeCap')::int
 or new.id<>new.player_id||':'||new.rarity then raise exception 'Permanent rarity cap mismatch';end if;

end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION credits_sandbox.check_instance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare d credits_sandbox.card_definitions;begin
 -- The aggregate row is locked by the transaction; the unique serial index also
 -- rejects competing direct inserts. No UPDATE privilege on immutable definitions.
 select * into d from credits_sandbox.card_definitions where id=new.definition;
 if new.serial>d.lifetime_cap or new.serial<>(select coalesce(max(serial),0)+1 from credits_sandbox.card_instances where definition=new.definition)
 or new.document->>'id' is distinct from new.id::text or new.document->>'definition' is distinct from d.id
 or new.document->>'playerId' is distinct from d.player_id or new.document->>'rarity' is distinct from d.rarity
 or (new.document->>'serial')::int is distinct from new.serial or (new.document->>'lifetimeCap')::int is distinct from d.lifetime_cap
 then raise exception 'Permanent serial/cap violation';end if;
 return new;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION credits_sandbox.check_nba_fixture_instance()

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare d credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_definitions;begin
 select * into d from credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_definitions where id=new.definition;
 if d.id is null or new.serial>d.lifetime_cap
  or new.serial<>(select coalesce(max(serial),0)+1 from credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_instances where definition=new.definition)
  or new.document->>'id' is distinct from new.id::text
  or new.document->>'definition' is distinct from d.id
  or new.document->>'playerId' is distinct from d.player_id
  or new.document->>'rarity' is distinct from d.rarity
  or (new.document->>'serial')::int is distinct from new.serial
  or (new.document->>'lifetimeCap')::int is distinct from d.lifetime_cap
  or exists(select 1 from credits_sandbox.card_instances where id=new.id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION credits_sandbox.finish_sale_push(p_listing text, p_subscription uuid, p_lease uuid, p_status text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_status not in ('sent','expired','retry') then raise exception 'Invalid outcome'; end if;
 update credits_sandbox.sale_push_deliveries set status=case when p_status='retry' then case when attempts>=12 then 'failed' else 'queued' end else p_status end,
 delivered_at=case when p_status='sent' then clock_timestamp() else null end,
 available_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>least(21600,60*power(2,least(attempts,8))::integer)),last_error=case when p_status='sent' then null else p_status end
 where listing_id=p_listing and subscription_id=p_subscription and lease=p_lease and status='sending';
 if found and p_status='expired' then update credits_sandbox.web_push_subscriptions set enabled=false,updated_at=clock_timestamp() where id=p_subscription; end if;
end $function$

begin

 'rounds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'name',c.name,'configuration',(select configuration from beta_fantasy.lineup_configurations where version=c.rules->>'lineup_version'),'fixtures',n.fixtures)) from beta_fantasy.competitions c join sports_feed.nfl_rounds n on n.competition_id=c.id where c.rules->>'lineup_version' is not null and c.scored_at is null and not exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.round_controls where competition_id=c.id and not enabled)),'[]'),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION credits_sandbox.project_fixture_inventory()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare target record; retained jsonb; owned jsonb; e jsonb:=new.document->'economy';begin
 if e is null then return new;end if;
 for target in
  select distinct c.value->>'owner' member,p.identity->>'sport' sport
  from jsonb_each(coalesce(old.document->'commerce'->'cards','{}')||coalesce(new.document->'commerce'->'cards','{}')) c
  join credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_instances i on i.id::text=c.key
  join credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_players p on p.id=i.document->>'playerId'
  union
  select distinct c.value->>'owner',p.identity->>'sport'
  from jsonb_each(coalesce(old.document->'commerce'->'cards','{}')) c
  join credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_instances i on i.id::text=c.key
  join credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_players p on p.id=i.document->>'playerId'
 loop
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(card),'[]') into retained
  from sports_feed.sport_sandbox_inventory inv,jsonb_array_elements(inv.cards) card
  where inv.user_id=target.member::uuid and inv.sport=target.sport and card->>'inventory_source' is distinct from 'credits-fixture-v1';
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',i.id,'card_id',i.id,'player_id',coalesce(p.identity->>'fixturePlayerId',p.id),
    'owner_id',target.member,'name',p.identity->>'name','team',p.identity->>'currentTeam',
    'sport',target.sport,'position',p.identity->>'position','eligible_positions',coalesce(p.identity->'eligiblePositions',jsonb_build_array(p.identity->>'position')),
    'tier',i.document->>'rarity','serial',i.serial,'max_supply',(i.document->>'lifetimeCap')::int,
    'multiplierTenths',10,'status','active','season',case when credits_sandbox.is_roster_beta_player(p.identity) then 'REAL PLAYER · BETA INVENTORY' else 'SYNTHETIC TEST' end,'inventory_class',p.identity->>'inventoryClass','roster_source',p.identity->'rosterBeta','verifiedJerseyNumber',null,
    'inventory_source','credits-fixture-v1','listed',exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(new.document->'listings') l where l.value->>'card'=i.id::text and l.value->>'status'='OPEN')
  ) order by i.id),'[]') into owned
  from credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_instances i join credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_players p on p.id=i.document->>'playerId'
  where p.identity->>'sport'=target.sport and new.document->'commerce'->'cards'->i.id::text->>'owner'=target.member
   and e->'packs'->(i.document->>'source')->>'openedAt' is not null;
  if exists(select 1 from sports_feed.sport_sandbox_access where user_id=target.member::uuid) then
   insert into sports_feed.sport_sandbox_inventory(user_id,sport,cards) values(target.member::uuid,target.sport,coalesce(retained,'[]')||owned)
   on conflict(user_id,sport) do update set cards=excluded.cards where sport_sandbox_inventory.cards is distinct from excluded.cards;
  end if;
 end loop;
 return new;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.card_player_history(player text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare viewer uuid; answer jsonb; player_aliases text[];
begin
 viewer:=beta_fantasy.production_eligible();
 if viewer is null or viewer<>auth.uid() or not beta_private.active_member_session() then raise exception 'Active admitted session required'; end if;
 if length(player)>120 or length(player)<1 then raise exception 'Invalid player'; end if;
 -- Verified provider identity bridge, never player-name matching. Preserve old Core history.
 select array_agg(distinct id) into player_aliases from (
  select player id
  union select n.player_id::text from sports_feed.nfl_players n join credits_sandbox.permanent_players p on p.provider_id=n.provider_id and p.sport='nfl' and p.provider='nflverse' where p.id=player
  union select p.id from sports_feed.nfl_players n join credits_sandbox.permanent_players p on p.provider_id=n.provider_id and p.sport='nfl' and p.provider='nflverse' where n.player_id::text=player
 ) identities;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(record),'[]') into answer from (
 select jsonb_build_object('season',c.season,'week',c.round,'fixture',coalesce(mapping.mapping->>'gameId',f->>'id'),'scheduledAt',f->>'scheduledAt',
 'position',coalesce(ps.position,bp.position),'rules',j.body#>'{period,rules}',
 'revision',coalesce((source->>'revision')::int,0),'observedAt',source->>'observedAt',
 'final',j.body->>'finalisedAt' is not null,'visible',coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true),
 'source',case when not coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) or source is null or p is null then null else
 jsonb_build_object('status',source->>'status','availability',p->>'availability','stats',p->'stats') end) record
 from sports_feed.nfl_rounds n join sports_feed.streams s on s.id=n.stream_id
 join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=n.competition_id
 join lateral(select body from sports_feed.journal where stream_id=n.stream_id order by revision desc limit 1) j on true
 cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(j.body#>'{period,fixtures}') f
 left join beta_fantasy.round_controls rc on rc.competition_id=c.id
 left join sports_feed.postgame_mapping mapping on mapping.stream_id=n.stream_id and mapping.fixture_id=f->>'id'
 left join lateral(select position from credits_sandbox.current_player_status where id=any(player_aliases) order by id limit 1) ps on true
 left join lateral(select position from beta_fantasy.players where id::text=any(player_aliases) order by id limit 1) bp on true
 left join lateral(select value source from jsonb_array_elements(j.body->'sources') with ordinality where value->>'fixtureId'=f->>'id' order by ordinality desc limit 1) latest on true
 left join lateral(select value p from jsonb_array_elements(source->'players') where value->>'playerId'=any(player_aliases) order by value->>'playerId'=player desc limit 1) stats on true
 where n.purpose='member' and s.purpose='member' and j.body->>'scope'='authorised-free-beta'
 and f->'playerIds' ?| player_aliases and coalesce(ps.position,bp.position) is not null
 and c.locks_at<=clock_timestamp()
 order by c.season desc,c.round desc,c.id limit 300
 ) records;
 return answer;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.game_day_standings()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare viewer uuid; answer jsonb;
begin
 viewer:=beta_fantasy.production_eligible();
 if viewer is null or viewer<>auth.uid() or not beta_private.active_member_session() then raise exception 'Active admitted session required';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'competitionId',c.id,'label',c.name,'season',c.season,'week',c.round,'mode',c.rules->>'mode',
  'closesAt',c.locks_at,'serverTime',extract(epoch from clock_timestamp())*1000,
  'fixtures',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('scheduledAt',f->>'scheduledAt','status',f->>'status')) from jsonb_array_elements(n.fixtures)f),'[]'),
  -- Exact saved rule content and lineup version define a compatible series, not a mutable display label.
  'series',md5(jsonb_build_object('rules',coalesce(j.body#>'{period,rules}',sr.rules),'lineup',c.rules->>'lineup_version')::text),
  'visible',coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true),
  'finalised',coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) and j.body->>'finalisedAt' is not null and c.scored_at is not null
    and jsonb_array_length(coalesce(j.calculated->'rows','[]'))>0
    and jsonb_array_length(j.calculated->'rows')=(select count(*) from beta_fantasy.entries e where e.competition_id=c.id)
    and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(j.calculated->'rows') x where x->>'status'<>'final' or x->>'centipoints' is null),
  'updatedAt',j.recorded_at,'feedMode','postgame',
  'lastSuccessfulSyncAt',(select max(pc.checked_at) from sports_feed.postgame_cache pc join sports_feed.raw_revisions pr on pr.id=pc.raw_id where pr.body->>'dataset' in ('weekly','pbp')),'lastCheckedAt',n.last_checked,'dataDelayed',jsonb_array_length(n.issues)>0,
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'key',md5('docked-standings-v1:'||e.user_id::text),'name',coalesce(nullif(t.name,''),'Unnamed team'),
    'isMe',e.user_id=viewer,
    'totalPlayers',jsonb_array_length(e.snapshot),
    'completedPlayers',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then
      (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(score.value->'players') p
       where p->>'centipoints' is not null and jsonb_array_length(p->'matches')>0
       and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p->'matches') m where m->>'sourceStatus' is distinct from 'completed' or m->'score' is null or m->'score'='null'::jsonb)) else null end,
    'knownCentipoints',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true)
      and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(score.value->'players') p cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(p->'matches') m where m->'score' is not null and m->'score'<>'null'::jsonb)
      then score.value->'knownCentipoints' else null end,
    'centipoints',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then score.value->'centipoints' else null end,
    'rank',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then score.value->'rank' else null end,
    'status',case when not coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then 'under-review' else coalesce(score.value->>'status','pending-data') end,
    'lineup',case when e.user_id=viewer or (
      c.locks_at<=clock_timestamp() and coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true)
      and exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.lineup_publication_policy p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.enabled and p.approved_at<=clock_timestamp())
      and beta_private.admitted(e.user_id)
      and exists(select 1 from beta_private.social_profiles p join beta_private.social_profiles vp on vp.user_id=viewer and vp.status in ('active','restricted') where p.user_id=e.user_id and beta_private.social_profile_visible(vp.id,p.id,false))
      and (case when c.rules->>'lock_policy'='round-wide-v1' then
        exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.entries competitor where competitor.competition_id=c.id and competitor.user_id=viewer)
        and jsonb_array_length(e.snapshot)=jsonb_array_length(cfg.configuration->'slots')
      else (select count(*) from beta_fantasy.slot_locks l where l.competition_id=c.id and l.user_id=e.user_id and l.locked_at<=clock_timestamp() and (l.snapshot->>'kickoff')::timestamptz<=clock_timestamp()
        and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(cfg.configuration->'slots') s where s->>'id'=l.slot))=jsonb_array_length(cfg.configuration->'slots') end)
      and jsonb_array_length(cfg.configuration->'slots')>0
    ) then (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
       'serial',card.value->'serial','max_supply',card.value->'max_supply','slot',card.value->>'slot','name',card.value->>'name','position',card.value->>'position','tier',card.value->>'tier','team',card.value->>'team',
       'fixtures',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('scheduledAt',f->>'scheduledAt','status',f->>'status')) from jsonb_array_elements(n.fixtures) f where f->'playerIds' ? (card.value->>'player_id')),'[]'::jsonb),
       'multiplier',coalesce((card.value->>'multiplierTenths')::numeric/10,(card.value->>'multiplier')::numeric),
       'completed',coalesce(player.value->>'centipoints' is not null and jsonb_array_length(player.value->'matches')>0
       and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(player.value->'matches') m where m->>'sourceStatus' is distinct from 'completed' or m->'score' is null or m->'score'='null'::jsonb),false) and coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true),
       'locked',(c.rules->>'lock_policy'='round-wide-v1' and c.locks_at<=clock_timestamp()) or (l.slot is not null and l.locked_at<=clock_timestamp()),
       'baseCentipoints',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then player.value->'baseCentipoints' else null end,
       'centipoints',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then player.value->'centipoints' else null end,
       'status',case when not coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then 'under-review' when player.value->>'centipoints' is null then 'pending-data'
       when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(player.value->'matches') m where m->>'availability'='confirmed-dnp') then 'dnp'
       when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(player.value->'matches') m where m->>'availability'='bye') then 'bye'
       when jsonb_array_length(player.value->'matches')>0 and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(player.value->'matches') m where m->>'sourceStatus' is distinct from 'completed') then 'final'
       else 'provisional' end,
       'parts',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('statistic',part->>'statistic','quantity',part->'quantity','centipoints',part->'centipoints')) from jsonb_array_elements(player.value->'matches') m cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(m#>'{score,parts}') part),'[]') else '[]'::jsonb end
      ) order by card.value->>'slot'),'[]')
      from jsonb_array_elements(e.snapshot) original
      left join beta_fantasy.slot_locks l on l.competition_id=c.id and l.user_id=e.user_id and l.slot=original->>'slot'
      cross join lateral(select coalesce(l.snapshot,original) value) card
      left join lateral(select p value from jsonb_array_elements(score.value->'players') p where p->>'cardId'=coalesce(card.value->>'card_id',card.value->>'id') limit 1) player on true
    ) else null end
  ) order by (score.value->>'rank')::integer nulls last,md5('docked-standings-v1:'||e.user_id::text))
  from beta_fantasy.entries e
  left join beta_fantasy.team_names t on t.user_id=e.user_id
  left join lateral(select x value from jsonb_array_elements(j.calculated->'rows') x where x->>'member'=e.user_id::text limit 1) score on true
  where e.competition_id=c.id),'[]')
 ) order by c.season desc,c.round desc,c.id),'[]') into answer
 from sports_feed.nfl_rounds n join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=n.competition_id
 join beta_fantasy.scoring_rules sr on sr.id=c.scoring_id
 join beta_fantasy.lineup_configurations cfg on cfg.version=c.rules->>'lineup_version'
 left join beta_fantasy.round_controls rc on rc.competition_id=c.id
 left join lateral(select body,calculated,recorded_at from sports_feed.journal where stream_id=n.stream_id order by revision desc limit 1) j on true
 where n.purpose='member' and c.sport='nfl' and c.rules->>'mode' in ('SALARY_CAP','OPEN');
 return answer;
end $function$

       'status',case when not coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then 'under-review' when player.value->>'centipoints' is null then 'pending-data'
       when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(player.value->'matches') m where m->>'availability'='confirmed-dnp') then 'dnp'
       when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(player.value->'matches') m where m->>'availability'='bye') then 'bye'
       when jsonb_array_length(player.value->'matches')>0 and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(player.value->'matches') m where m->>'sourceStatus' is distinct from 'completed') then 'final'
       else 'provisional' end,
       'parts',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('statistic',part->>'statistic','quantity',part->'quantity','centipoints',part->'centipoints')) from jsonb_array_elements(player.value->'matches') m cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(m#>'{score,parts}') part),'[]') else '[]'::jsonb end
      ) order by card.value->>'slot'),'[]')
      from jsonb_array_elements(e.snapshot) original
      left join beta_fantasy.slot_locks l on l.competition_id=c.id and l.user_id=e.user_id and l.slot=original->>'slot'
      cross join lateral(select coalesce(l.snapshot,original) value) card
      left join lateral(select p value from jsonb_array_elements(score.value->'players') p where p->>'cardId'=coalesce(card.value->>'card_id',card.value->>'id') limit 1) player on true
    ) else null end
  ) order by (score.value->>'rank')::integer nulls last,md5('docked-standings-v1:'||e.user_id::text))
  from beta_fantasy.entries e
  left join beta_fantasy.team_names t on t.user_id=e.user_id
  left join lateral(select x value from jsonb_array_elements(j.calculated->'rows') x where x->>'member'=e.user_id::text limit 1) score on true
  where e.competition_id=c.id),'[]')
 ) order by c.season desc,c.round desc,c.id),'[]') into answer
 from sports_feed.nfl_rounds n join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=n.competition_id
 join beta_fantasy.scoring_rules sr on sr.id=c.scoring_id
 join beta_fantasy.lineup_configurations cfg on cfg.version=c.rules->>'lineup_version'
 left join beta_fantasy.round_controls rc on rc.competition_id=c.id
 left join lateral(select body,calculated,recorded_at from sports_feed.journal where stream_id=n.stream_id order by revision desc limit 1) j on true
 where n.purpose='member' and c.sport='nfl' and c.rules->>'mode' in ('SALARY_CAP','OPEN');
 return answer;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.member_results()

 SECURITY DEFINER

begin
 viewer := beta_fantasy.production_eligible();
 if viewer is null or viewer<>auth.uid() or not beta_private.active_member_session() then raise exception 'Admission required'; end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item order by created_at desc),'[]'::jsonb) into output from (
  select s.created_at,jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'purpose',s.purpose,'metadata',s.display_metadata,
   'revision',j.revision,'recordedAt',j.recorded_at,'view',
   (j.calculated-'rows')||jsonb_build_object('rows',(
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(r-'member'),'[]'::jsonb) from jsonb_array_elements(j.calculated->'rows') r
    where s.purpose='historical-acceptance' or r->>'member'=viewer::text
   ))) item
  from sports_feed.streams s
  join lateral (select * from sports_feed.journal where stream_id=s.id order by revision desc limit 1) j on true
  where (s.purpose='member' and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.stream_members m where m.stream_id=s.id and m.user_id=viewer))
   or (s.purpose='historical-acceptance' and beta_private.owner_gameplay_identity(viewer) and coalesce(auth.jwt()->>'aal','')='aal2')
  order by s.created_at desc limit 30
 ) visible;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.member_review_context()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid; answer jsonb;begin
 u:=beta_fantasy.production_eligible();
 if u is null or u<>auth.uid() or not beta_private.active_member_session() then raise exception 'Active admitted member required';end if;
 select jsonb_build_object('rounds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'id',c.id,'name',c.name,'season',c.season,'week',c.round,'mode',coalesce(c.rules->>'mode','LEGACY'),
 'closesAt',c.locks_at,'finalAt',c.scored_at,'entryCount',(select count(*) from beta_fantasy.entries e where e.competition_id=c.id),
 'entered',exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.entries e where e.competition_id=c.id and e.user_id=u),
 'updatedAt',j.recorded_at,'rules',coalesce(j.body->'period'->'rules',sr.rules),
 'lineup',lc.configuration,'visible',coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true),'streamId',n.stream_id
 ) order by c.season desc,c.round desc,c.name) from sports_feed.nfl_rounds n
 join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=n.competition_id
 join beta_fantasy.scoring_rules sr on sr.id=c.scoring_id
 left join beta_fantasy.lineup_configurations lc on lc.version=c.rules->>'lineup_version'
 left join beta_fantasy.round_controls rc on rc.competition_id=c.id
 left join lateral(select body,recorded_at from sports_feed.journal where stream_id=n.stream_id order by revision desc limit 1)j on true
 where n.purpose='member'), '[]'),
 'cardHistory',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(i.key, (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('at',h->'at','event',case when h->>'from' is null then 'Issued' when s.document->'listings' ? (h->>'reference') then 'Purchased / sold' when s.document->'swaps' ? (h->>'reference') then 'Swapped' else 'Ownership transferred' end)),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(s.document->'cards'->i.key->'history')h) || case when (s.document#>array['economy','packs',s.document#>>array['economy','instances',i.key,'source'],'openedAt']) is not null and (s.document#>array['economy','packs',s.document#>>array['economy','instances',i.key,'source'],'openedAt']) <> 'null'::jsonb then jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('event','Pack opened','at',s.document#>array['economy','packs',s.document#>>array['economy','instances',i.key,'source'],'openedAt'])) else '[]'::jsonb end)
 from credits_sandbox.state s,jsonb_each(s.document->'commerce'->'cards')i where s.id and i.value->>'owner'=u::text),'{}')) into answer;
 return answer;
end$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''

declare u uuid:=auth.uid();begin
 if current_setting('docked.nba_private_beta',true) is distinct from 'enabled'
 or current_setting('docked.multi_sport',true) is distinct from 'isolated-preview'
 or not exists(select 1 from sports_feed.nba_beta_control where enabled)
 or not exists(select 1 from sports_feed.nba_beta_access where user_id=u and enabled and expires_at>clock_timestamp())
 or not exists(select 1 from sports_feed.sport_sandbox_access where user_id=u)
 or not beta_private.active_member_session()

 or not exists(select 1 from auth.users a join auth.sessions s on s.user_id=a.id
   where a.id=u and s.id=nullif(auth.jwt()->>'session_id','')::uuid
   and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>clock_timestamp())
   and a.email_confirmed_at is not null and not coalesce(a.is_anonymous,false)
   and coalesce(a.banned_until,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp())

 then raise exception 'Verified NBA beta access required';end if;

 n:=n+1;
 end loop;return n;end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.owned_sport_inventory(u uuid, sport_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with ledger as materialized (
  select document->'commerce'->'cards' commerce,document->'cards' cards,
   document->'economy'->'instances' instances,document->'entitlements' entitlements
  from credits_sandbox.state where id
 ), owned_ids as materialized (
  select c.key id from ledger l cross join lateral jsonb_each(l.commerce)c
  where c.value->>'owner'=u::text and c.value->>'sport'=sport_id and l.cards ? c.key
   and (l.instances->c.key->>'source' is null or l.entitlements->(l.instances->c.key->>'source')->>'status'='OPENED')
  union all
  select c.id::text from beta_fantasy.cards c join beta_fantasy.editions e on e.id=c.edition_id
   join beta_fantasy.players p on p.id=e.player_id
  where c.owner_id=u and p.sport=sport_id
   and not exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.pack_items pi join beta_fantasy.packs pa on pa.id=pi.pack_id where pi.card_id=c.id and pa.opened_at is null)
   and not exists(select 1 from ledger l where l.commerce ? c.id::text)
 )
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(card),'[]') || sports_feed.weekly_core_inventory(u,sport_id)
 from sports_feed.sport_sandbox_inventory i cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(i.cards)card
 where i.user_id=u and i.sport=sport_id and card->>'owner_id'=u::text and card->>'sport'=sport_id
  and exists(select 1 from owned_ids o where o.id=card->>'id')

 or not exists(select 1 from beta_private.roles where user_id=auth.uid() and role='owner')
 or not beta_private.owner_gameplay_identity(auth.uid()) then raise exception 'Owner MFA required'; end if;
 return jsonb_build_object(
  'serverTime',clock_timestamp(),
  'runs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x) from (
    select started_at,finished_at,
     case when finished_at is null and started_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '10 minutes' then 'interrupted' else status end status,detail
    from sports_feed.nfl_worker_runs order by started_at desc limit 12)x),'[]'),
  'sources',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'dataset',r.body->>'dataset','observedAt',r.observed_at,'checkedAt',c.checked_at,'nextAttempt',c.next_attempt,
    'error',c.error_code,'completionObservedAt',(select max(o.observed_at) from sports_feed.completion_observations o where o.raw_id=r.id)))
    from sports_feed.postgame_cache c left join sports_feed.raw_revisions r on r.id=c.raw_id),'[]'),
  'rounds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'competition',n.competition_id,'lastChecked',n.last_checked,'nextCheck',n.next_check,'issues',n.issues,
    'fixtures',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('game',f->>'gameId','kickoff',f->>'scheduledAt',
      'completionObservedAt',c.first_observed_at)) from jsonb_array_elements(n.fixtures)f
      left join sports_feed.completions c on c.game_id=f->>'gameId'),'[]')))
    from sports_feed.nfl_rounds n where n.purpose='member'),'[]'));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.play_standings_before_status()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare viewer uuid; answer jsonb;
begin
 viewer:=beta_fantasy.production_eligible();
 if viewer is null or viewer<>auth.uid() or not beta_private.active_member_session() then raise exception 'Active admitted session required';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'competitionId',c.id,'label',c.name,'season',c.season,'week',c.round,'mode',c.rules->>'mode',
  -- Exact saved rule content and lineup version define a compatible series, not a mutable display label.
  'series',md5(jsonb_build_object('rules',coalesce(j.body#>'{period,rules}',sr.rules),'lineup',c.rules->>'lineup_version')::text),
  'visible',coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true),
  'finalised',coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) and j.body->>'finalisedAt' is not null and c.scored_at is not null
    and jsonb_array_length(coalesce(j.calculated->'rows','[]'))>0
    and jsonb_array_length(j.calculated->'rows')=(select count(*) from beta_fantasy.entries e where e.competition_id=c.id)
    and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(j.calculated->'rows') x where x->>'status'<>'final' or x->>'centipoints' is null),
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'key',md5('docked-standings-v1:'||e.user_id::text),'name',coalesce(nullif(t.name,''),'Unnamed team'),
    'isMe',e.user_id=viewer,
    'centipoints',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then score.value->'centipoints' else null end,
    'rank',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then score.value->'rank' else null end,
    'status',case when not coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then 'under-review' else coalesce(score.value->>'status','pending-data') end,
    'lineup',case when e.user_id=viewer or (
      c.locks_at<=clock_timestamp() and coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true)
      and exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.lineup_publication_policy p where p.competition_id=c.id and p.enabled and p.approved_at<=clock_timestamp())
      and beta_private.admitted(e.user_id)
      and exists(select 1 from beta_private.social_profiles p join beta_private.social_profiles vp on vp.user_id=viewer and vp.status in ('active','restricted') where p.user_id=e.user_id and beta_private.social_profile_visible(vp.id,p.id,false))
      and (select count(*) from beta_fantasy.slot_locks l where l.competition_id=c.id and l.user_id=e.user_id and l.locked_at<=clock_timestamp() and (l.snapshot->>'kickoff')::timestamptz<=clock_timestamp()
        and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(cfg.configuration->'slots') s where s->>'id'=l.slot))=jsonb_array_length(cfg.configuration->'slots')
      and jsonb_array_length(cfg.configuration->'slots')>0
    ) then (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
       'serial',card.value->'serial','max_supply',card.value->'max_supply','slot',card.value->>'slot','name',card.value->>'name','position',card.value->>'position','tier',card.value->>'tier','team',card.value->>'team',
       'fixtures',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('scheduledAt',f->>'scheduledAt','status',f->>'status')) from jsonb_array_elements(n.fixtures) f where f->'playerIds' ? (card.value->>'player_id')),'[]'::jsonb),
       'multiplier',coalesce((card.value->>'multiplierTenths')::numeric/10,(card.value->>'multiplier')::numeric),
       'locked',l.slot is not null and l.locked_at<=clock_timestamp(),
       'baseCentipoints',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then player.value->'baseCentipoints' else null end,
       'centipoints',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then player.value->'centipoints' else null end,
       'status',case when not coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then 'under-review' when player.value->>'centipoints' is null then 'pending-data' else score.value->>'status' end,
       'parts',case when coalesce(rc.standings_visible,true) then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('statistic',part->>'statistic','quantity',part->'quantity','centipoints',part->'centipoints')) from jsonb_array_elements(player.value->'matches') m cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(m#>'{score,parts}') part),'[]') else '[]'::jsonb end
      ) order by card.value->>'slot'),'[]')
      from jsonb_array_elements(e.snapshot) original
      left join beta_fantasy.slot_locks l on l.competition_id=c.id and l.user_id=e.user_id and l.slot=original->>'slot'
      cross join lateral(select coalesce(l.snapshot,original) value) card
      left join lateral(select p value from jsonb_array_elements(score.value->'players') p where p->>'cardId'=coalesce(card.value->>'card_id',card.value->>'id') limit 1) player on true
    ) else null end
  ) order by (score.value->>'rank')::integer nulls last,md5('docked-standings-v1:'||e.user_id::text))
  from beta_fantasy.entries e
  left join beta_fantasy.team_names t on t.user_id=e.user_id
  left join lateral(select x value from jsonb_array_elements(j.calculated->'rows') x where x->>'member'=e.user_id::text limit 1) score on true
  where e.competition_id=c.id),'[]')
 ) order by c.season desc,c.round desc,c.id),'[]') into answer
 from sports_feed.nfl_rounds n join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=n.competition_id
 join beta_fantasy.scoring_rules sr on sr.id=c.scoring_id
 join beta_fantasy.lineup_configurations cfg on cfg.version=c.rules->>'lineup_version'
 left join beta_fantasy.round_controls rc on rc.competition_id=c.id
 left join lateral(select body,calculated from sports_feed.journal where stream_id=n.stream_id order by revision desc limit 1) j on true
 where n.purpose='member' and c.sport='nfl' and c.rules->>'mode' in ('SALARY_CAP','OPEN');
 return answer;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.rarity_inventory(u uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with ledger as materialized (
  select document#>'{commerce,cards}' cards,document->'listings' listings,
   document#>'{economy,packs}' packs,document#>>'{economy,id}' economy_id,
   (document#>>'{economy,enabled}')::boolean enabled
  from credits_sandbox.state where id
 ), owned as materialized (
  select c.key id from ledger l cross join lateral jsonb_each(l.cards)c
  where c.value->>'owner'=u::text and l.economy_id='invited-nfl-test-v2' and l.enabled
 ), opened as materialized (
  select p.key id from ledger l cross join lateral jsonb_each(l.packs)p where p.value->>'openedAt' is not null
 ), listed as materialized (
  select l.value->>'card' id from ledger s cross join lateral jsonb_each(s.listings)l where l.value->>'status'='OPEN'
 ), roster as materialized (select * from credits_sandbox.current_player_status), limited as (
  select jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'edition_id',i.definition,'owner_id',u,'serial',i.serial,
   'tradeable',true,'created_at',to_timestamp((i.document->>'mintedAt')::numeric/1000),'acquired_at',to_timestamp((i.document->>'mintedAt')::numeric/1000),
   'name',p.identity->>'name','position',r.position,'tier',d.rarity,'season','lifetime','kind','regular',
   'max_supply',d.lifetime_cap,'player_id',p.id,'team',r.team,'edition_team',i.document->>'printedTeam','provider_id',p.provider_id,
   'colour','#1677FF','shirt',1,'sport','nfl','inventory_scope','invited-nfl-test-v2',
   'status',case when r.status='ACT' and r.checked_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '72 hours' then 'active' else 'unavailable' end,
   'listed',exists(select 1 from listed l where l.id=i.id::text),
   'multiplier',(rc.document->'rarities'->d.rarity->>'multiplierTenths')::numeric/10,
   'multiplierTenths',(rc.document->'rarities'->d.rarity->>'multiplierTenths')::int,'rarityVersion',d.rarity_version) card
  from owned o join credits_sandbox.card_instances i on i.id::text=o.id
  join credits_sandbox.card_definitions d on d.id=i.definition
  join credits_sandbox.permanent_players p on p.id=d.player_id
  join roster r on r.id=p.id join credits_sandbox.rarity_configuration rc on rc.version=d.rarity_version
  where exists(select 1 from opened where id=i.document->>'source')
   and exists(select 1 from credits_sandbox.access where user_id=u and enabled)
 ) select coalesce(jsonb_agg(card),'[]') from limited
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.rarity_transfer_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(71820342);
 if exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(old.document->'commerce'->'cards') a where a.value->>'owner' is distinct from new.document->'commerce'->'cards'->a.key->>'owner' and sports_feed.card_entry_reserved(a.key)) then

 return new;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.raw_retention_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if tg_op='UPDATE' and old.expires_at<=clock_timestamp() and old.body is not null and new.body is null and new.purged_at is not null and new.purged_at<=clock_timestamp() and new.purged_at>=old.expires_at
 and (to_jsonb(new)-'body'-'purged_at')=(to_jsonb(old)-'body'-'purged_at') then return new;end if;
 raise exception 'Raw evidence immutable except expired payload purge';end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.round_wide_registration_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.rules->>'lock_policy'='round-wide-v1' and (
   (new.sport<>'nfl' and not (current_setting('docked.multi_sport',true)='isolated-preview' and new.rules->>'inventory_scope'='isolated-multi-sport-v1' and new.sport in ('afl','nrl','basketball','football'))) or new.rules->>'lineup_version' is null
   or new.rules->>'mode' not in ('SALARY_CAP','OPEN')
   or new.locks_at<=clock_timestamp()
 ) then raise exception 'Round-wide policy requires a new future NFL round';end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.round_wide_write_guard()

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare cid uuid;begin
 cid:=case when tg_op='INSERT' then new.competition_id else old.competition_id end;

 if exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.competitions where id=cid
   and rules->>'lock_policy'='round-wide-v1' and locks_at<=clock_timestamp())
 then raise exception 'Round locked: all selections closed at the round deadline';end if;
 if tg_op='DELETE' then return old;end if;return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.sandbox_identity()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare u uuid:=auth.uid();begin if current_setting('docked.nba_private_beta',true)='enabled' then return sports_feed.private_beta_sport_identity();end if;
 if current_setting('docked.multi_sport',true) is distinct from 'isolated-preview'
 or auth.jwt()->>'aal' is distinct from 'aal2'
 or not exists(select 1 from sports_feed.sport_sandbox_access where user_id=u)
 or not exists(select 1 from auth.users a join auth.sessions s on s.user_id=a.id
 where a.id=u and s.id=nullif(auth.jwt()->>'session_id','')::uuid
 and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>clock_timestamp())
 and a.email_confirmed_at is not null and not coalesce(a.is_anonymous,false)
 and coalesce((to_jsonb(a)->>'banned_until')::timestamptz,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp())
 then raise exception 'Verified isolated tester session and MFA required';end if;
 return u;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.sandbox_nba_journals()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''

declare u uuid; answer jsonb;begin
 u:=sports_feed.sandbox_identity();
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('competition_id',c.id,'state_hash',j.state_hash,'body',j.body)),'[]') into answer
 from beta_fantasy.competitions c
 join sports_feed.sport_rounds r on r.competition_id=c.id and r.sport='basketball'
 join lateral (select x.state_hash,x.body from scoring_beta.journal x
   where x.stream_id='sim:basketball:'||c.id::text order by x.revision desc limit 1) j on true
 where c.sport='basketball' and c.rules->>'inventory_scope'='isolated-multi-sport-v1'
 and c.rules->>'lineup_version'='docked-nba-weekly-lineup-proposal-v1'
 and c.locks_at<=clock_timestamp()
 and j.body->'period'->'rules'->>'version'='docked-nba-weekly-proposal-v1'
 and exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.entries e where e.competition_id=c.id and e.user_id=u);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.sandbox_sport_journals(sport_id text)

 and j.body->>'scope'='simulated-beta' and j.body->'period'->>'sport'=sport_id

 and exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.entries e where e.competition_id=c.id and e.user_id=u);
 return answer;
end$function$

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(c||jsonb_build_object('source_status',r.status,'status_observed_at',r.checked_at,
 'availability_reason',case when r.checked_at is null then 'Roster source data is unavailable; eligibility cannot be verified.'
 when r.checked_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '72 hours' then 'Roster source is stale; eligibility awaits a fresh observation.'
 when r.status='RET' then 'Roster source reports retired. Existing ownership is preserved.'
 when r.status<>'ACT' then 'Roster source reports '||r.status||' (not active). Current rules require active roster status for new selections. This is not an injury diagnosis or confirmed DNP.'
 else null end)), '[]')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.seven_inventory_before_review(u uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select sports_feed.rarity_inventory(u)||coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'id',a.id,'card_id',a.id,'owner_id',u,'edition_id',e.id,'player_id',permanent.id,'canonical_player_id',permanent.id,
 'tier','CORE','position',pl.position,'name',pl.name,'team',np.current_team,'sport','nfl',
 'status',case when np.source_status='ACT' and np.observed_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '72 hours' then 'active' else 'unavailable' end,
 'listed',exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.listings where card_id=a.id and state='active'),
 'serial',a.serial,'max_supply',0,'multiplier',1,'multiplierTenths',10,'rarityVersion',rc.version,
 'colour',pl.colour,'shirt',pl.shirt,'tradeable',a.tradeable,'season',e.season,'kind',e.kind,
 'created_at',a.created_at,'acquired_at',a.created_at,'provider_id',np.provider_id,'inventory_scope','invited-nfl-test-v2')),'[]')
 from beta_fantasy.cards a join beta_fantasy.editions e on e.id=a.edition_id
 join beta_fantasy.players pl on pl.id=e.player_id join sports_feed.nfl_players np on np.player_id=pl.id
 join credits_sandbox.permanent_players permanent on permanent.provider_id=np.provider_id
 join credits_sandbox.rarity_configuration rc on rc.version=(select document->'economy'->>'rarityVersion' from credits_sandbox.state where id)
 where a.owner_id=u and e.tier='CORE'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.seven_lock_due()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare n integer;begin
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(71820342);
 insert into beta_fantasy.slot_locks(competition_id,user_id,slot,snapshot,locked_at)
 select e.competition_id,e.user_id,s->>'slot',s,
   case when c.rules->>'lock_policy'='round-wide-v1' then c.locks_at else (s->>'kickoff')::timestamptz end
 from beta_fantasy.entries e join beta_fantasy.competitions c on c.id=e.competition_id,jsonb_array_elements(e.snapshot)s
 where c.rules->>'lineup_version' is not null and
   (case when c.rules->>'lock_policy'='round-wide-v1' then c.locks_at else (s->>'kickoff')::timestamptz end)<=clock_timestamp()
 on conflict do nothing;
 get diagnostics n=row_count;
 update sports_feed.nfl_rounds nr set locked_snapshot='[]',locked_at=c.locks_at
 from beta_fantasy.competitions c where c.id=nr.competition_id and c.rules->>'lineup_version' is not null and nr.locked_at is null and c.locks_at<=clock_timestamp();
 return n;
end$function$

 select case when s='nfl' then sports_feed.weekly_core_allowed(u) else
 s in ('afl','nrl') and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.weekly_sport_programmes where sport=s and enabled)
 and beta_private.admitted(u)
 and exists(select 1 from credits_sandbox.access where user_id=u and enabled)
 and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.sport_sandbox_access where user_id=u)
 and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.private_beta_sports where sport=s and enabled)
 and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.nba_beta_control where enabled)
 and exists(select 1 from sports_feed.nba_beta_access where user_id=u and enabled and expires_at>clock_timestamp())
 and exists(select 1 from beta_public.profiles where id=u and disabled_at is null)
 and not exists(select 1 from beta_fantasy.members where user_id=u and (revoked_at is not null or expires_at<=clock_timestamp())) end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.weekly_core_inventory(u uuid, s text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(c||jsonb_build_object('owner_id',u,'acquired_at',p.opened_at,'created_at',p.opened_at)),'[]')
 from sports_feed.weekly_core_packs p cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(p.receipt->'cards') c
 where p.user_id=u and p.sport=s and s in ('afl','nrl') and p.opened_at is not null
$function$
